title.zh: 卷160 志一百三十五 邦交八 奥斯马加 秘鲁 巴西 葡萄牙 墨西哥 刚果
title.en: Volume 160 Treatises 135: Foreign Relations 8, Ottoman Empire, Peru, Brazil, Portugal, Mexico, Congo
title.raw: 卷160 志一百三十五 邦交八 奥斯马加 秘鲁 巴西 葡萄牙 墨西哥 刚果

sentences.zh: 奧斯馬加即奧地利亞，久互市廣東，粵人以其旗識之，稱雙鷹國，

translations.literal: Osimaga is Austria; for a long time it has traded at Guangdong. The people of Guangdong recognize it by its flag and call it the Double-Eagle Country.
translations.idiomatic: Osimaga—that is, Austria—had long traded at Guangdong. Cantonese knew the realm by its banner and called it the Country of the Double Eagle.

sentences.zh: 同治八年，遣使臣畢慈來華，介英使阿禮國請立約，並呈其君主敕諭，欲在京議約。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tongzhi, an envoy, Bizhi, was dispatched to China; through the British envoy Alcock he requested the conclusion of a treaty, and presented his sovereign's instructions, wishing to negotiate the treaty in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tongzhi, it then sent the envoy Bizhi to China. Introduced by the British minister Alcock, he asked to conclude a treaty, presented his sovereign's instructions, and sought to negotiate in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 總署以在京議約與歷來各國成案不符，應先照會三口通商大臣，由三口通商大臣請旨。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen held that negotiating a treaty in Beijing did not accord with established precedents for all countries, and that notice should first be sent to the Minister for the Three Treaty Ports, who would request instructions from the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen replied that treaty talks in Beijing ran counter to precedent for foreign states, and that the Minister for the Three Treaty Ports should first be notified so he could seek imperial instructions.

sentences.zh: 奧使遞照會三口通商大臣崇厚以聞。

translations.literal: The Austrian envoy submitted a note to the Minister for the Three Treaty Ports, Chonghou, to report the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The Austrian envoy forwarded a note to Chonghou, Minister for the Three Treaty Ports, for transmission to the court.

sentences.zh: 朝議許之，命總理各國事務衙門大臣、兵部尚書董恂會同崇厚辦理。

translations.literal: The court deliberation approved it, and ordered Dong Xun, Grand Minister of the Zongli Yamen and Minister of War, to handle the matter jointly with Chonghou.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the arrangement and ordered Dong Xun, a grand minister of the Zongli Yamen and Minister of War, to conduct the negotiations together with Chonghou.

sentences.zh: 奧使呈所遞條約四十九款，大致均從各國內採集而成。

translations.literal: The Austrian envoy presented the treaty he had brought, of forty-nine articles, which on the whole had been assembled from those of various countries.
translations.idiomatic: The Austrian envoy submitted the forty-nine-article treaty he had brought, compiled for the most part from other nations' agreements.

sentences.zh: 董恂等於應刪應添各節，逐一改定，而奧使於恂所添「商人不准充領事官」一語，不原列入約，於恂所刪傳教一條仍列入約。

translations.literal: Dong Xun and others revised each section that should be deleted or added. The Austrian envoy would not agree to include in the treaty the phrase Dong had added, "merchants may not serve as consular officers," yet still kept in the treaty the article on missionary activity that Dong had deleted.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Xun and his colleagues revised every clause slated for deletion or addition. The Austrian envoy refused to accept Dong's insertion of "merchants may not serve as consular officers," but insisted on retaining the missionary article Dong had struck out.

sentences.zh: 迭議不決。

translations.literal: Repeated negotiations failed to reach a decision.
translations.idiomatic: Round after round of talks ended without agreement.

sentences.zh: 久之，奧使始允刪傳教一條，而于「商人不准充領事官」一節，仍欲另備照會，于畫押日一同呈遞，許之。

translations.literal: After a long time the Austrian envoy finally agreed to delete the article on missionary activity; as for the clause "merchants may not serve as consular officers," he still wished to prepare a separate note to present together on the day of signing, and this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually the Austrian envoy agreed to drop the missionary clause. On "merchants may not serve as consular officers," he still wanted a separate note filed on the day of signing, and the Chinese side consented.

sentences.zh: 遂訂定和約四十五款，通商章程九款，稅則一冊。

translations.literal: Thereupon a treaty of forty-five articles, commercial regulations of nine articles, and a tariff schedule in one volume were concluded.
translations.idiomatic: They then finalized a treaty of forty-five articles, nine articles of commercial regulations, and a volume of tariff schedules.

sentences.zh: 是年奧夾板船名伊來撤各利亞，用英國旗號，私運外國鹽一百餘包，計重二萬餘斤，進口。

translations.literal: That year the Austrian schooner named Eleutheria, flying the British flag, smuggled in more than a hundred bales of foreign salt, weighing in all more than twenty thousand jin.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Austrian schooner Eleutheria entered port under the British flag, having smuggled in more than a hundred bales of foreign salt totaling over twenty thousand jin in weight.

sentences.zh: 天津稅務司函致總署。

translations.literal: The customs superintendent at Tianjin wrote to the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin customs superintendent reported the matter to the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 總署以奧船運鹽進口，顯違條約，應查拏，並知照英領事前往查起。

translations.literal: The Yamen held that an Austrian vessel bringing salt into port clearly violated the treaty and should be seized and investigated, and notified the British consul to proceed with the inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen ruled that importing salt on an Austrian ship plainly breached the treaty, ordered a seizure and investigation, and instructed the British consul to take up the case.

sentences.zh: 十年九月，奧換約屆期，使臣嘉理治照會總署請換約，特旨派江蘇布政使恩錫赴上海互換。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the tenth year the term for exchanging the Austrian treaty arrived; Minister George notified the Yamen requesting exchange, and a special edict appointed En Xi, provincial administration commissioner of Jiangsu, to go to Shanghai for the exchange.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the tenth year the Austrian treaty came due for renewal. Minister George petitioned the Yamen, and the throne specially appointed En Xi, Jiangsu provincial administration commissioner, to exchange instruments at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 嗣因約本內漢文所載善後章程第五、第八兩款，均有引用條約「第八條」字樣，其奧文內皆誤寫作「第一條」；

translations.literal: Later, because in the Chinese text of the treaty the fifth and eighth articles of the supplementary regulations both cited "Article 8" of the treaty, while in the Austrian text all were wrongly written as "Article 1";
translations.idiomatic: The exchange was delayed because articles 5 and 8 of the supplementary regulations in the Chinese text cited "Article 8," of the treaty, whereas the Austrian text read "Article 1;"

sentences.zh: 又稅則進口項下呀闌治木，漢文載明長不過「三十五幅地」，奧文誤寫作「五十五幅地」；

translations.literal: further, under import items in the tariff schedule for alang wood, the Chinese text specified a length not exceeding "thirty-five fathoms," while the Austrian text wrongly read "fifty-five fathoms";
translations.idiomatic: under the tariff's import list for alang wood, the Chinese version capped length at "thirty-five fathoms," but the Austrian text gave "fifty-five fathoms";

sentences.zh: 又羽綾、羽紗、羽綢、小呢等類，漢文載明「每丈」，奧文誤寫作「每疋」，須更改。

translations.literal: for feathered damask, feathered gauze, feathered silk, and small woolens and the like, the Chinese text read 'per zhang,' while the Austrian text wrongly read 'per bolt'—all had to be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: for feathered damasks, gauzes, silks, and small woolens, the Chinese text measured duty 'per zhang' while the Austrian read 'per bolt,' and these too required correction.

sentences.zh: 至十一年六月始竣事。

translations.literal: Only in the sixth month of the eleventh year was the matter completed.
translations.idiomatic: The exchange was not completed until the sixth month of the eleventh year.

sentences.zh: 十一年，奧使照會總署，以接奉本國文，稱去歲本國出有政令，自七月十七日起，凡量奧斯馬加各樣海船噸數之法，皆與英國丈量噸數之法相同，請劄知總稅務司轉知各口海關遵行。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Austrian envoy notified the Yamen that he had received a dispatch from his country stating that last year his government had issued an order that from the seventeenth day of the seventh month onward, the method of measuring the tonnage of all Osimaga seagoing vessels would be the same as the British method of measuring tonnage, and requested that the Inspector General of Customs be instructed to inform all port customs to comply.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the Austrian minister wrote to the Yamen with word from home that, from the seventeenth day of the seventh month of the previous year, Austrian vessels were to be tonned by the same rules as British ships, and asked that the Inspector General notify every customs house accordingly.

sentences.zh: 十二年，穆宗親政，奧隨各國公使覲見。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Emperor Muzong assumed personal rule; the Austrian envoy joined the envoys of all countries in audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when Emperor Muzong took up personal rule, the Austrian minister joined the other foreign envoys in formal audience.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，使臣李鳳苞函致李鴻章，稱：「奧君長子明年正月十六日婚期，中國雖未派駐使，宜令鄰邦駐使往賀，以盡友誼。」

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu, Minister Li Fengbao wrote to Li Hongzhang, stating: "The Austrian sovereign's eldest son is to marry on the sixteenth day of the first month of next year. Although China has not yet appointed a resident minister, a resident minister of a neighboring state should be sent to offer congratulations, to fulfill the bonds of friendship."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu, Minister Li Fengbao wrote Li Hongzhang, stating: "The Austrian heir will marry on the sixteenth day of the first month of the coming year. Although China has not yet posted a resident minister, a neighboring power's minister should attend the wedding to honor the friendship."

sentences.zh: 總署即電飭李鳳苞屆期往賀。

translations.literal: The Yamen immediately telegraphed orders for Li Fengbao to go and offer congratulations on the appointed day.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen at once wired Li Fengbao to attend on the appointed day.

sentences.zh: 十年夏四月，以翰林院侍講許景澄充出使德美和奧大臣，駐德。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the tenth year, Xu Jingcheng, Hanlin expositor, was appointed minister plenipotentiary to Germany, the United States, the Netherlands, and Austria, resident in Germany.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month of the tenth year Xu Jingcheng, Hanlin expositor, was appointed envoy to Germany, the United States, the Netherlands, and Austria, with residence in Berlin.

sentences.zh: 十三年，代以內閣學士洪鈞。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was replaced by Hong Jun, a Grand Secretariat bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Hong Jun, a Grand Secretariat bachelor, succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，洪鈞赴奧呈遞國書，見奧主于馬加行宮，頌答如禮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year Hong Jun went to Austria to present his letter of credence, received the Austrian sovereign at the Magyar palace, and exchanged formal congratulations as custom required.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year Hong Jun presented his credentials in Austria, was received by the emperor at the Magyar palace, and exchanged the customary courtesies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，奧爾而伯納親王來京，欲瞻仰天壇，許之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter Prince Erzherzog Albrecht came to the capital wishing to visit the Temple of Heaven, and this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Archduke Albrecht came to Beijing and was allowed to visit the Temple of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 十六年秋七月，復以許景澄充出使俄德奧和大臣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn of the sixteenth year Xu Jingcheng was again appointed minister plenipotentiary to Russia, Germany, Austria, and the Netherlands.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month of the sixteenth year Xu Jingcheng was again named envoy to Russia, Germany, Austria, and the Netherlands.

sentences.zh: 十七年夏四月，景澄赴奧通問，覲見奧主，奧主為述前歲有兵艦抵華，承中國官員以禮相待，屬為陳謝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the seventeenth year Jingcheng went to Austria on a courtesy visit, had audience with the Austrian sovereign, and the sovereign related that the previous year a warship had reached China and Chinese officials had received it with courtesy, asking him to convey thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month of the seventeenth year Xu Jingcheng called at Vienna, was received by the emperor, and was asked to thank Beijing for courteously receiving an Austrian warship the year before.

sentences.zh: 九月，奧使畢格哩本覲見上於承光殿。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Austrian envoy Biligriben had audience with the Emperor at the Chengguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Austrian Minister Biligriben was received in audience at the Chengguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 十八年，奧主以西曆六十七年即馬加王位，距今滿二十五年，西俗以為慶事，先期由奧外部通知各國公使詣馬加都城申賀。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Austrian sovereign, by the Western calendar in the sixty-seventh year of the Magyar throne and now twenty-five years from that accession, regarded the occasion in Western custom as a celebration; the Austrian foreign ministry beforehand notified the envoys of all countries to proceed to the Magyar capital to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Vienna marked the twenty-fifth anniversary of the Magyar accession in Western calendar year sixty-seven; the foreign ministry invited all envoys to the Magyar capital to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 許景澄備文傳賀，旋即親赴伯達彼斯馬加都城。

translations.literal: Xu Jingcheng prepared a congratulatory dispatch and then went in person to Buda-Pesth, the Magyar capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jingcheng sent congratulations and then traveled in person to Buda-Pesth.

sentences.zh: 覲見奧主申謝悃，奧亦發電至京答謝。

translations.literal: He had audience with the Austrian sovereign to express sincere thanks, and Austria also telegraphed thanks to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was received by the emperor to convey Beijing's sincere thanks, and Vienna telegraphed its thanks in return.

sentences.zh: 二十年四月，許景澄照會奧與俄、德、和等外部，申明總署現章，酌定洋機進口稅文。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twentieth year Xu Jingcheng notified the foreign ministries of Austria, Russia, Germany, the Netherlands, and others, setting forth the Yamen's current regulations and fixing the import duty on foreign-made machinery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twentieth year Xu Jingcheng circularized the Austrian, Russian, German, and Dutch foreign offices with the Yamen's current rules and the agreed import tax on foreign machinery.

sentences.zh: 十月，皇太后六旬壽，奧使隨各使呈遞國書致賀，上見之於文華殿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the Empress Dowager's sixtieth birthday, the Austrian envoy joined the other envoys in presenting letters of state with congratulations; the Emperor received them at the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, for the Empress Dowager's sixtieth birthday, the Austrian minister joined the other envoys in presenting congratulatory state letters, and the Emperor received them in the Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，奧主叔父病故，許景澄請旨致唁，許之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the Austrian sovereign's uncle died; Xu Jingcheng requested instructions to send condolences, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, when the Austrian emperor's uncle died, Xu Jingcheng sought permission to offer condolences, and the court assented.

sentences.zh: 二十二年十月，以都察院左都御史楊儒充出使俄奧和大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-second year Yang Ru, Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, was appointed minister plenipotentiary to Russia, Austria, and the Netherlands.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-second year Yang Ru, Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, was appointed envoy to Russia, Austria, and the Netherlands.

sentences.zh: 十一月，駐德奧使送節略，稱奧廷擬派瓦耳布倫為駐京專使，請中國國家允認，中國派使駐奧亦如之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the minister to Germany and Austria sent a summary note stating that the Austrian court proposed to appoint Walbrunn resident minister in Beijing and requested China's recognition, and that China should likewise appoint a minister resident in Austria.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the minister accredited to Germany and Austria reported that Vienna intended to send Walbrunn as resident minister in Beijing and asked for China's recognition, with a reciprocal Chinese minister at Vienna.

sentences.zh: 二十三年四月，奧使齊干覲見上於文華殿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-third year the Austrian envoy Qigan had audience with the Emperor at the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-third year Minister Qigan of Austria was received in audience at the Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春三月，命內閣學士桂春使俄兼使奧。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring in the twenty-sixth year Gui Chun, a bachelor of the Grand Secretariat, was ordered envoy to Russia and concurrently to Austria.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring in the twenty-sixth year Gui Chun of the Grand Secretariat was appointed envoy to Russia with concurrent accreditation to Austria.

sentences.zh: 七月，拳匪之變，奧兵隨德、美、法、英、意、日、俄聯軍入京師。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, during the Boxer uprising, Austrian troops entered the capital with the allied armies of Germany, the United States, France, Britain, Italy, Japan, and Russia.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, amid the Boxer crisis, Austrian forces marched into Beijing with the German, American, French, British, Italian, Japanese, and Russian allies.

sentences.zh: 二十八年四月，三品卿吳德章充出使奧國大臣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-eighth year Wu Dezang, a third-rank courtier, was appointed minister to Austria.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-eighth year Wu Dezang, a third-rank official, was appointed minister to Austria.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，代以山東道員楊晟。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Yang Sheng, a Shandong circuit intendant, replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Yang Sheng, a Shandong circuit intendant, took his place.

sentences.zh: 三十年十月，奧使齊幹覲見上於皇極殿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the thirtieth year the Austrian envoy Qigan had audience with the Emperor at the Huangji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the thirtieth year Minister Qigan was received in audience at the Huangji Hall.

sentences.zh: 三十一年八月，以三品京堂李經邁充出使駐奧大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirty-first year Li Jingmai, a third-rank official of the capital, was appointed resident minister to Austria.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirty-first year Li Jingmai, a third-rank capital official, was named resident minister to Austria.

sentences.zh: 三十二年三月，奧使顧新斯基覲見上於乾清宮。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirty-second year the Austrian envoy Guxinski had audience with the Emperor at the Qianqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirty-second year Minister Guxinski was received in audience at the Qianqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 三十三年七月，以外務部參議雷補同充出使駐奧大臣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirty-third year Lei Bu, a counselor of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was appointed concurrently resident minister to Austria.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirty-third year Lei Bu, counselor in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was named co-minister resident in Austria.

sentences.zh: 秘魯在南亞美利加洲，

translations.literal: Peru lies in South America.
translations.idiomatic: Peru is located in South America.

sentences.zh: 同治十一年，秘魯國瑪也西船私在澳門拐華民二百餘人，行抵日本橫濱，經日本截留訊辦，知會中國派員前往。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, the Peruvian vessel Maria secretly abducted more than two hundred Chinese at Macao; reaching Yokohama in Japan, it was detained and investigated by Japan, which notified China to dispatch officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, a Peruvian ship, the Maria, had secretly seized more than two hundred Chinese laborers at Macao. When it reached Yokohama, Japan detained the vessel, investigated the case, and invited China to send officials.

sentences.zh: 時通商大臣何璟派補用同知知縣陳福勳偕英、美兩領事派員前往，旋各運回，並謝日本。

translations.literal: At the time the trade minister He Jing dispatched the acting subprefect and magistrate Chen Fuxun, together with British and American consular staff, to proceed; the laborers were soon all returned, and thanks were sent to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Trade Minister He Jing then sent Acting Subprefect Chen Fuxun with British and American consular officers. The workers were soon repatriated, and China thanked Japan for its intervention.

sentences.zh: 十二年，秘魯遣使來華議立約。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Peru sent an envoy to China to negotiate a treaty.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Peru dispatched an envoy to China to negotiate a treaty.

sentences.zh: 已而秘使葛爾西耶到津謁李鴻章，鴻章詰以虐待華工等事，不允相商。

translations.literal: Before long the Peruvian envoy Gelcier arrived at Tianjin to call on Li Hongzhang; Hongzhang questioned him on the mistreatment of Chinese laborers and the like, and refused to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Peruvian Minister Gelcier called on Li Hongzhang at Tianjin. Li confronted him over abuses of Chinese workers and declined to enter talks.

sentences.zh: 秘使旋以本國新立雇工章程，實無淩虐情事，牒鴻章。

translations.literal: The Peruvian envoy then memorialized Hongzhang that his country had newly established labor regulations and that in truth there was no oppression.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy promptly wrote to Li, citing Peru's new labor regulations and insisting that no abuse had occurred.

sentences.zh: 鴻章覆牒，謂：「貴國新立雇工章程雖尚公道，但查同治八年、十年間，華民公稟內所稱『苛求、打罵、枷鎖、饑寒，雖立合同，而章程虛設，雖曰送回，而限滿無歸』等語，是即保護華工未能照辦之證據也。

translations.literal: Hongzhang replied in a memorial, stating: 'Although your country's newly established labor regulations are fairly equitable, investigation shows that in petitions submitted by Chinese subjects in the eighth and tenth years of Tongzhi there appear such phrases as "excessive demands, beatings, cangues and fetters, hunger and cold; though contracts were made, the regulations were empty; though repatriation was promised, when terms expired there was no return"—which is evidence that protection of Chinese laborers has not been carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Li replied that although Peru's new labor code seemed fair on paper, petitions from Chinese subjects in the eighth and tenth years of Tongzhi had complained of 'harsh demands, beatings, shackles, hunger and cold; contracts signed but rules ignored; repatriation promised but never delivered when terms expired'—clear proof that worker protection had not been enforced.

sentences.zh: 又來文所載一千八百五十五年八月十四日議立搭客船規，不准載大幫之人。

translations.literal: Your dispatch also cites regulations for passenger vessels agreed on the fourteenth day of the eighth month of 1855, forbidding the carriage of large groups of people.
translations.idiomatic: Your note also cited passenger-ship rules adopted on 14 August 1855, which barred transporting laborers in large gangs.

sentences.zh: 查，日本國扣留秘魯瑪也西船，載有拐買華民二百三十人之多，據各國領事公同訊問，船主苛酷相待，飲食不繼，並有割去辮髮、鞭打囚禁等事。

translations.literal: Investigation shows that when Japan detained the Peruvian vessel Maria, it was carrying as many as two hundred thirty abducted Chinese; according to joint questioning by the consuls of various countries, the shipowner treated them harshly, food was insufficient, and there were instances of cutting off queues, whipping, and imprisonment.
translations.idiomatic: Japan's detention of the Maria revealed more than two hundred thirty kidnapped Chinese aboard. Consuls of several nations jointly examined the crew and found the captain brutal, rations inadequate, and workers subjected to queue-cutting, flogging, and confinement.

sentences.zh: 又據粵海關稅務司報稱，『，秘魯船一隻在澳門販載華工三百十三人，同治十年，秘魯船十三隻在澳門販載華工五千九百八十七人，同治十一年，秘魯船十九隻在澳門販載華工九千三百八十一人』。

translations.literal: Further, according to a report from the superintendent of customs at Guangdong, 'one Peruvian vessel at Macao transported three hundred thirteen Chinese laborers; in the tenth year of Tongzhi, thirteen Peruvian vessels at Macao transported five thousand nine hundred eighty-seven Chinese laborers; in the eleventh year of Tongzhi, nineteen Peruvian vessels at Macao transported nine thousand three hundred eighty-one Chinese laborers.'
translations.idiomatic: Customs at Guangdong further reported that one Peruvian ship had taken 313 workers from Macao; in the tenth year of Tongzhi, thirteen Peruvian ships removed 5,987; in the eleventh year, nineteen ships took 9,381.

sentences.zh: 此皆系大幫，秘國並不查禁。

translations.literal: All these were large gangs, and Peru did not investigate or prohibit them.
translations.idiomatic: Each case involved mass shipments that Peru never investigated or stopped.

sentences.zh: 近又據粵海關稅務司報稱，『本年七月間，廣東省城黃埔河面有秘魯船七隻前來招工，因其違背通行章程，諭令驅逐出口』。

translations.literal: Recently the Guangdong customs superintendent again reported: 'In the seventh month of this year seven Peruvian vessels came to recruit labor on the Huangpu River before Guangzhou city; because they violated the regulations in force, they were ordered expelled from port.'
translations.idiomatic: Customs also reported that in the seventh month of this year seven Peruvian ships had come to Huangpu to recruit labor and were expelled for violating current regulations.

sentences.zh: 以上各節，是又帆船禁載大幫華人未能照辦之證據也。

translations.literal: All the above are further evidence that the prohibition on sailing vessels carrying large gangs of Chinese has not been enforced.
translations.idiomatic: These facts again show that Peru has ignored its own ban on mass shipments of Chinese labor.

sentences.zh: 查上年中國通行各國照會內載，凡系無約各國，一概不准設局招工，其船隻不准搭載華工出洋。

translations.literal: Investigation shows that in last year's circular note to all countries China stated that countries without treaties may not establish labor-recruitment offices, and their vessels may not carry Chinese laborers overseas.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's circular to all powers had declared that states without treaties might neither open recruitment offices nor carry Chinese workers abroad.

sentences.zh: 即有約各國，亦不准在澳門招工。

translations.literal: Even treaty countries may not recruit labor at Macao.
translations.idiomatic: Even treaty powers were forbidden to recruit at Macao.

sentences.zh: 均經各國知照在案。

translations.literal: All countries have been notified and the matter is on record.
translations.idiomatic: Every power had been duly notified.

sentences.zh: 秘國向系無約之國，照章不准裝載華人出口。

translations.literal: Peru has always been a country without a treaty; under the regulations Chinese may not be loaded for export.
translations.idiomatic: Peru has never had a treaty with China and therefore may not export Chinese labor under these rules.

sentences.zh: 乃昨據貴大臣面稱，現載往秘魯華人已有十萬餘人，明系違背公法。

translations.literal: Yet yesterday Your Excellency stated in person that Chinese now transported to Peru already exceed one hundred thousand—a clear violation of public law.
translations.idiomatic: Yet you yourself said yesterday that more than a hundred thousand Chinese are already in Peru—an open breach of international practice.

sentences.zh: 況華民在秘魯重受淩虐，曾兩次公稟美國欽差轉達總理衙門，是以日前疊據英、美、法各大臣述知貴大臣欲來華議約，即經總理衙門王大臣照覆各國，以『秘魯向來專以拐販華工為事，華工受盡痛苦，其相待中國情形與別國不同，必須與伊國說明，先將所招華工全數送回中國，並聲明不准招工，方能商議立約，否則實難辦理』等語。

translations.literal: Moreover Chinese subjects in Peru have suffered severe oppression; twice they petitioned the American minister to relay word to the Zongli Yamen. Therefore when the ministers of Britain, America, and France recently informed us that Your Excellency wished to come to China to negotiate a treaty, the grand ministers of the Zongli Yamen replied to all countries that 'Peru has always specialized in kidnapping and selling Chinese laborers; the laborers have endured every suffering; its treatment of China differs from that of other countries; it must be made clear to that country that all recruited Chinese laborers must first be returned in full to China and that recruitment is forbidden before treaty negotiations can proceed—otherwise it truly cannot be handled.'
translations.idiomatic: Chinese in Peru have moreover been cruelly abused and twice appealed through the American minister to Beijing. When British, American, and French ministers lately reported your wish to negotiate, the Zongli Yamen replied to all legations that Peru had long trafficked in kidnapped labor, that its workers had suffered beyond endurance, and that China would treat Peru differently from other powers: every recruited worker must be sent home and further recruitment forbidden before any treaty talks—otherwise negotiations were impossible.

sentences.zh: 想貴大臣必已與聞，無煩贅述。」

translations.literal: Your Excellency must surely already have heard; there is no need to repeat at length."
translations.idiomatic: You will already have heard this; I need not elaborate."

sentences.zh: 旋據函稱遵照總署原議，先將所招華工全數送回中國，自可妥商。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward a letter stated that in accordance with the Yamen's original proposal, if all recruited Chinese laborers were first returned to China, negotiations could proceed smoothly.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy soon wrote that if Peru followed the Yamen's terms and repatriated every recruited worker, talks could proceed in good order.

sentences.zh: 鴻章訂期會議，屆時不至，鴻章責之。

translations.literal: Hongzhang set a date for talks; when the day came the envoy did not appear, and Hongzhang rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: Li fixed a date for negotiations, but the envoy failed to appear and was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 復請期，鴻章因再約期，至日，秘使偕愛勒謨爾秘妥士來。

translations.literal: He asked for another date; Hongzhang accordingly set a new appointment, and on the day the Peruvian envoy came with Elmore, the Peruvian interpreter.
translations.idiomatic: He requested another meeting; Li set a new date, and on the appointed day the envoy arrived with Elmore, the Peruvian interpreter.

sentences.zh: 適同知容閎由美國回津，鴻章令閎與議。

translations.literal: It happened that Subprefect Rong Hong had just returned to Tianjin from the United States; Hongzhang ordered Rong to join the negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: Subprefect Rong Hong had just returned from the United States, and Li directed him to take part in the talks.

sentences.zh: 秘使將鴻章原函取出，逐條剖辨，謂無苛待情事；

translations.literal: The Peruvian envoy produced Hongzhang's original letter and rebutted it article by article, claiming there had been no harsh treatment;
translations.idiomatic: The envoy produced Li's letter and answered each point, denying any mistreatment;

sentences.zh: 又謂中國既令無約之國不准招工，是以本國亟派使前來議約，以後自必照約互相稽查保護。

translations.literal: he also said that since China had forbidden countries without treaties to recruit labor, his country had urgently sent an envoy to negotiate a treaty, and hereafter both sides would certainly supervise and protect one another according to the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: he added that because China barred recruitment by states without treaties, Peru had hurried an envoy to Beijing and would thereafter enforce mutual oversight under a treaty.

sentences.zh: 並稱華工送回，可於約內聲明，除華人在秘魯設肆寓居，自不原歸，無庸送回，其餘工人等合同限滿，即令原主送回，分別辦理。

translations.literal: He further said that repatriation of laborers could be stated in the treaty: except for Chinese who had opened shops and taken residence in Peru and did not wish to return, who need not be sent back, all other workers whose contracts had expired would be ordered returned by their original employers, each case handled separately.
translations.idiomatic: Repatriation, he said, could be written into the treaty: merchants and residents who chose to stay need not return, but when other contracts expired the original employers must send workers home, case by case.

sentences.zh: 容閎因言美國向例，無立合同年限雇工之事。

translations.literal: Rong Hong then stated that in American practice there was no hiring of laborers under fixed-term contracts.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Hong noted that in the United States laborers were not bound by fixed-term contracts.

sentences.zh: 華民在金山等處傭工，去留自便，美官不能勉強勒掯。

translations.literal: Chinese in places such as the Gold Mountains might hire themselves out and come or go as they pleased; American officials could not compel or restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese workers in California and elsewhere were free to come and go, and American officials could neither compel nor detain them.

sentences.zh: 即有先立合同者，若不原當，隨時將合同繳銷，作為廢紙。

translations.literal: Even if a contract had been signed beforehand, if the worker was unwilling he could at any time surrender the contract and treat it as void.
translations.idiomatic: Even when a contract existed, an unwilling worker could cancel it at any time.

sentences.zh: 秘國亦應照辦。

translations.literal: Peru should likewise comply.
translations.idiomatic: Peru should follow the same practice.

sentences.zh: 秘使允商辦。

translations.literal: The Peruvian envoy agreed to negotiate the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy agreed to discuss the point.

sentences.zh: 鴻章仍以拐去華民為言。

translations.literal: Hongzhang still spoke of the abduction of Chinese subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Li continued to press the issue of kidnapped Chinese.

sentences.zh: 秘使怫然，謂即回國。

translations.literal: The Peruvian envoy took offense and said he would return home at once.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy took offense and threatened to leave for home.

sentences.zh: 屢議不決。

translations.literal: Repeated talks failed to reach a decision.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting after meeting ended without agreement.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，復與秘使接議，秘使自交所擬條約，鴻章不受。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year talks with the Peruvian envoy resumed; the envoy presented his own draft treaty, which Hongzhang refused to accept.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirteenth year negotiations resumed. The envoy submitted his own draft, which Li rejected.

sentences.zh: 久之，始定查辦華工專條，其文曰「現因秘國地方有華民多名，且有稱華民有受委屈之處。

translations.literal: After a long time a special article on investigation of Chinese laborers was finally settled; its text reads: 'At present there are many Chinese subjects in Peru, and some say that Chinese have suffered injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually they agreed on a special article on Chinese labor. It began: 'Many Chinese now live in Peru, and complaints of injustice have been raised.

sentences.zh: 茲會同商訂，先立通商條款，和好往來，庶幾彼此同心。

translations.literal: The parties have jointly agreed to establish commercial articles first and maintain amicable relations, so that both sides may act in concert.
translations.idiomatic: Both sides therefore agreed to open with commercial clauses and friendly intercourse, so that they might work in concert.

sentences.zh: 由中國派員往秘，將華民情形澈查，並示諭華工，以便周知一切，秘國無不力助，以禮接待。

translations.literal: China shall dispatch officials to Peru to conduct a thorough investigation of the condition of Chinese subjects and proclaim instructions to the laborers so that all may be fully informed; Peru shall assist to the utmost and receive them with courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: China would send commissioners to Peru to investigate conditions thoroughly and notify workers of their rights; Peru would assist fully and receive the commissioners courteously.

sentences.zh: 如查得實有受苦華工，合同年限未滿，不拘人數多寡，均議由委員知照地方官。

translations.literal: If suffering laborers are found in fact, whether or not their contracts have expired and regardless of number, the commissioners shall notify the local officials in each case.
translations.idiomatic: Where suffering workers were found, whether contracts had expired and regardless of numbers, commissioners would notify local authorities.

sentences.zh: 雇主倘不承認，即由地方官傳案訊斷。

translations.literal: If employers do not acknowledge the claim, local officials shall summon the parties and adjudicate.
translations.idiomatic: If employers disputed the matter, local officials would hear the case.

sentences.zh: 若華工仍抱不平，立許上告秘國各大員，再為覆查。

translations.literal: If laborers remain dissatisfied, they shall at once be permitted to appeal to high Peruvian officials for re-investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Workers who remained aggrieved might appeal to senior Peruvian officials for a fresh review.

sentences.zh: 凡僑寓秘國，無論何國人民，呈稟式樣最優者，華工應一體均霑其益。

translations.literal: Whatever petition form is most favorable to nationals of any country residing in Peru, Chinese laborers shall enjoy the same benefit equally.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese workers would enjoy the most favorable petition procedures granted to any foreign community in Peru.

sentences.zh: 自秘國核定此項章程之日起，凡華工合同已經期滿，若合同內有雇主應出回國船腳之議，該工人有原回國者，即當嚴令雇主出資送回。

translations.literal: From the day Peru ratifies these regulations, for all Chinese laborers whose contracts have expired, if the contract provides that the employer shall pay return passage and the worker wishes to return home, the employer shall be strictly ordered to pay for repatriation.
translations.idiomatic: From the date Peru approved these rules, whenever contracts expired and required employers to pay return passage, workers who wished to go home would be repatriated at employer expense.

sentences.zh: 又各華工合同若無送回字樣，合同已滿期，該工人無力自出船資，有原回國者，秘國應將該工人等附華船送回，船資無須工人自備，秘國自行料理」云云。

translations.literal: Further, for Chinese laborers whose contracts contain no provision for return, when contracts have expired and workers lack means to pay passage but wish to return home, Peru shall send such workers back on Chinese vessels; passage need not be paid by the workers themselves—Peru shall arrange it at its own expense,' and so forth.'
translations.idiomatic: Where contracts lacked repatriation clauses, expired workers who could not pay passage but wished to return would be sent home on Chinese ships at Peru's expense,' and so on.'

sentences.zh: 復將通商條約十九款及已訂查辦專條改定，因致總署，謂：「在秘使之意及各國公論，彼既允定查辦資遣華工專條，是秘魯已予中國以便宜，我亦當照各國和約，允以一律。

translations.literal: The commercial treaty of nineteen articles and the agreed special article on investigation were further revised, and a report was sent to the Yamen stating: 'In the Peruvian envoy's view and in international opinion, since Peru has agreed to the special article on investigation and repatriation of Chinese laborers, Peru has already granted China a concession, and China should likewise grant equal treatment according to the treaties of other countries.
translations.idiomatic: Li then revised the nineteen commercial articles and the labor investigation clause and reported to the Yamen: 'The envoy and foreign opinion alike held that by accepting investigation and repatriation Peru had made a major concession; China should therefore grant standard treaty terms.

sentences.zh: 現訂通商十九款，大致亦與西約詞意略同。

translations.literal: The nineteen commercial articles now concluded are on the whole similar in wording to Western treaties.
translations.idiomatic: The nineteen commercial articles largely followed Western treaty language.

sentences.zh: 然均經鴻章逐條酌改，如各約篇首所稱『互相較閱，俱屬妥當』或『妥善』字樣，轉覺不妥，茲將『俱屬妥協』四字刪去。

translations.literal: Yet each was revised article by article by Hongzhang; for example the phrase at the head of other treaties, 'mutually compared and all found proper' or 'proper and complete,' seemed inappropriate, and the four characters 'all mutually agreed' have now been deleted.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Li revised every article—for example deleting the formula 'mutually compared and found satisfactory' that opened other treaties.

sentences.zh: 各約欽差駐京往來，有彼國而無我國，茲先載明中國欽差。

translations.literal: Other treaties mention ministerial correspondence in Beijing for the foreign side but not for China; here China's minister is specified first.
translations.idiomatic: Other treaties named only foreign ministers in Beijing; this text explicitly recognized China's minister.

sentences.zh: 各約領事官無商人不准兼充明文，茲添『不得委商人代理』。

translations.literal: Other treaties lack explicit language forbidding merchants to serve as consuls; here is added 'merchants may not be appointed as agents.'
translations.idiomatic: Where other treaties were silent on merchants serving as consuls, Li added 'merchants may not be appointed as agents.'

sentences.zh: 各約遊歷通商執照，秘使不肯刪通商貨物字樣，茲特添入『貨物應照報單章程辦理』。

translations.literal: Other treaties' travel and trade permits—the Peruvian envoy would not delete the words on trade goods; here is specially added 'goods shall be handled according to the manifest regulations.'
translations.idiomatic: The envoy refused to remove trade-goods language from travel permits, so Li added 'goods must be declared under manifest rules.'

sentences.zh: 各約多以英、法文為憑，茲改『彼此各用本國文字，亦可兼看英文』。

translations.literal: Most treaties rely on English and French texts; this is changed to 'each side shall use its own national script, and English may also be consulted.'
translations.idiomatic: Where other treaties privileged English and French, Li stipulated that each side would use its own language, with English available for reference.

sentences.zh: 其餘凡通商、納稅、兵船、商船、控告、詞訟各節，均將中國一面敘入。

translations.literal: All remaining sections on trade, taxation, warships, merchant vessels, complaints, and litigation likewise incorporate China's side.
translations.idiomatic: Every remaining clause on trade, taxes, warships, merchant shipping, complaints, and litigation was revised to protect China's interests.

sentences.zh: 所最要者，招工流弊無窮。

translations.literal: Most important of all, the abuses of labor recruitment are endless.
translations.idiomatic: Most critical was the endless abuse of labor recruitment.

sentences.zh: 澳門販運已久，華工既在秘國受苦，以前雖允查辦，以後若仍開招，害將何所底止？

translations.literal: Trafficking from Macao has long continued; Chinese laborers have already suffered in Peru; although investigation was once promised, if recruitment is reopened, where will the harm end?
translations.idiomatic: Macao had long been a hub of the trade; workers already suffered in Peru. Investigation alone would mean little if recruitment resumed—where would the harm end?

sentences.zh: 茲會訂第六款，上半節照美國續約，云『別有招致之法，均非所准』，下復添敘『不准在澳門及各口岸勉強誘騙中國人運載出洋，違者其人嚴懲，船隻罰辦』等語。

translations.literal: Article 6 is now agreed: the first half follows the American supplementary treaty—'any other method of recruitment is not permitted'—and below is added 'it is forbidden to coerce or deceive Chinese at Macao and all ports for transport overseas; violators shall be severely punished and vessels penalized,' and similar language.
translations.idiomatic: Article 6 followed the American supplementary treaty—'no other method of recruitment is permitted'—and added that coercion or deception at Macao or any port was forbidden, with severe penalties for offenders and vessels.

sentences.zh: 嗣後中國但能照約嚴禁，不獨秘魯不敢違犯，即各國招工之舉，亦得援引辨證。

translations.literal: Hereafter if China can strictly enforce the treaty, not only will Peru not dare violate it, but recruitment by other countries may also be argued by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: If China enforced the clause, Peru would not dare violate it, and other powers' recruitment practices could be challenged by precedent.

sentences.zh: 又前訂查辦華工專條，商令派員前往，秘使允即遵照。」

translations.literal: Further, regarding the previously agreed special article on investigation of Chinese laborers, officials were instructed to be dispatched, and the Peruvian envoy agreed to comply at once."
translations.idiomatic: On the earlier labor investigation article, officials were to be sent, and the envoy promised immediate compliance."

sentences.zh: 旋派容閎往查辦。

translations.literal: Rong Hong was soon dispatched to conduct the investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Hong was promptly sent to Peru to investigate.

sentences.zh: 容閎查辦訖，報告華工到彼，被賣開山、種蔗，及糖寮、鳥糞島等處虐待情形，合同限內打死及自盡、投火爐糖鍋死者甚多，實可慘憫。

translations.literal: When Rong Hong completed his investigation he reported that upon arrival Chinese laborers were sold to work in mines, sugar planting, sugar mills, guano islands, and the like, and suffered abuse; within the contract term many were beaten to death, committed suicide, or died by throwing themselves into furnace fires and sugar vats—truly pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: Rong's report described workers sold to mines, cane fields, sugar mills, and guano islands, abused throughout their contracts, beaten or driven to suicide, or killed in furnace fires and boiling vats—a record of appalling suffering.

sentences.zh: 會屆換約之期，秘魯遣使臣愛勒謨爾來華求換約，

translations.literal: When the term for exchanging the treaty arrived, Peru sent Minister Elmore to China to request renewal.
translations.idiomatic: When the treaty came due for renewal, Peru sent Minister Elmore to request an exchange of instruments.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，派巡撫丁日昌為換約大臣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu, Governor Ding Richang was appointed minister for the exchange.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu, Governor Ding Richang was appointed to exchange the treaty.

sentences.zh: 日昌謂：「去年中國所以與秘國立約者，因秘國葛使照會內言秘國設有新章新例，保護華民，盡除弊端。

translations.literal: Richang stated: 'Last year China concluded a treaty with Peru because in Minister Gelcier's note he said Peru had established new regulations to protect Chinese subjects and remove all abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Ding said: 'China signed last year because Minister Gelcier's note promised new regulations to protect Chinese subjects and end every abuse.

sentences.zh: 乃立約之後，派員前往秘國確查，始知華工受屈，顯與條約內保護優待之例相背。

translations.literal: Yet after the treaty was concluded, when officials were sent to Peru for thorough investigation, it became clear that Chinese laborers had suffered injustice, plainly contrary to the treaty's provisions for protection and favorable treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the commissioners sent afterward found workers still abused, in plain violation of the treaty's promises of protection and fair treatment.

sentences.zh: 甫經立約，而秘國即種種違約，是不能不加一照會，聲明換約後即當遵約辦理，再不能仍照從前之淩虐。」

translations.literal: The treaty had only just been concluded when Peru at once violated it in various ways; a note must therefore be added declaring that after renewal Peru must comply with the treaty and could no longer treat workers as before."
translations.idiomatic: Hardly was the treaty signed when Peru broke it in multiple ways. Ding insisted on a note requiring compliance after renewal and an end to the old abuses."

sentences.zh: 秘使聞之，不待辭畢，即怫然去。

translations.literal: When the Peruvian envoy heard this, without waiting for the speech to finish he departed in anger.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy, hearing this, left in a rage before Ding had finished.

sentences.zh: 日昌以秘使無禮，因致總署，請暫緩換約。

translations.literal: Richang, considering the Peruvian envoy discourteous, reported to the Yamen requesting postponement of the treaty exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Ding reported the envoy's discourtesy to the Yamen and asked to delay the exchange.

sentences.zh: 四年，秘魯因澳門停止招工，香港英總督又申嚴禁，秘魯乃赴廣東省城與美商同孚洋行私立運載華工合同，五年為期，每年得船費洋銀十六萬圓，設局招誘。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, because Macao had stopped labor recruitment and the British governor of Hong Kong had also tightened prohibitions, Peru went to Guangzhou city and privately concluded with the American firm Russell & Co. a contract to transport Chinese laborers for five years, receiving sixteen thousand dollars in ship fees annually, and set up an office to recruit by deception.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, with Macao and Hong Kong both tightening bans, Peru went to Guangzhou and privately contracted with Russell & Co. to ship laborers for five years at 160,000 dollars a year in freight, operating a recruitment office.

sentences.zh: 粵督聞之，即予查禁。

translations.literal: When the governor-general of Guangdong heard of it, he at once investigated and prohibited it.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong governor-general promptly investigated and banned the operation.

sentences.zh: 秘使詣天津謁鴻章，拒之。

translations.literal: The Peruvian envoy called on Hongzhang at Tianjin and was refused.
translations.idiomatic: A Peruvian envoy called on Li Hongzhang at Tianjin and was turned away.

sentences.zh: 時出使大臣為陳蘭彬，雖由美使兼日秘，並未赴秘。

translations.literal: At the time the minister abroad was Chen Lanbin; although accredited to America with concurrent charge of Japan and Peru, he had not gone to Peru.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Chen Lanbin was accredited to the United States with concurrent charge of Japan and Peru but never visited Peru.

sentences.zh: 七年，以津海關道鄭藻如為出使美日秘大臣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Zheng Zaoru, intendant of the Tianjin customs, was appointed minister to the United States, Japan, and Peru.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Zheng Zaoru, Tianjin customs intendant, became minister to the United States, Japan, and Peru.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，始由美赴秘，謁總統遞國書，開辦使署於利馬都城，奏派參贊一員代辦使事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year he finally proceeded from America to Peru, had audience with the president and presented his letter of credence, opened a legation in the capital Lima, and memorialized the appointment of a counselor to handle legation affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year he reached Peru from the United States, presented credentials to the president, opened a legation in Lima, and appointed a counselor to manage affairs.

sentences.zh: 又於嘉理約海口設領事一員，管理華民事宜，仍禁絕招工，並咨請查拿廣州城外私設招工行棧。

translations.literal: A consul was also established at the port of Callao to manage Chinese affairs; recruitment remained forbidden, and orders were sent to investigate private recruitment offices outside Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A consul was posted at Callao for Chinese affairs. Recruitment remained banned, and officials were asked to raid illegal hiring offices near Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二年，鄭藻如歸，迭以傅雲龍、張廕桓、崔國因、楊儒充公使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Zheng Zaoru returned; Fu Yunlong, Zhang Yinhuan, Cui Guoyin, and Yang Ru succeeded him as ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng returned in the twelfth year; Fu Yunlong, Zhang Yinhuan, Cui Guoyin, and Yang Ru later served as ministers.

sentences.zh: 又增設代理領事十，就秘笈中之廉正者充之，遇事報使署，由參贊區處，公使仍不駐秘。

translations.literal: Ten acting consuls were added, chosen from upright Peruvians; on matters they reported to the legation, the counselor handled them, and the minister still did not reside in Peru.
translations.idiomatic: Ten acting consuls, chosen from respectable Peruvians, reported to the legation counselor while the minister remained non-resident.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，秘總統即位，各國均有國書致賀，介由美使請總署代達。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, when the Peruvian president assumed office, all countries sent letters of congratulation; Peru asked the American minister to request the Yamen to transmit theirs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Peru's new president received congratulatory letters from all powers; Peru asked the American minister to forward China's through the Yamen.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，始頒國書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year credentials were finally issued.
translations.idiomatic: China issued formal credentials in the twenty-second year.

sentences.zh: 二十三年六月，駐秘代辦李經敘行抵嘉理約，因疫疾盛行恐傳染，阻止入口，從秘制也。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-third year Acting Minister Li Jingxu arrived at Callao; because epidemic disease was rampant and entry might spread infection, he was barred from landing—a Peruvian regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-third year Acting Minister Li Jingxu reached Callao but was barred from landing because of epidemic quarantine rules.

sentences.zh: 久之始聽入。

translations.literal: Only after a long time was he permitted to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Entry was permitted only after a long delay.

sentences.zh: 時公使楊儒赴秘遞國書，秘外部先派護衛大臣一員在嘉理約迎伺，隨派火車接至利馬，又派副外部在車站迎伺。

translations.literal: At the time Minister Yang Ru went to Peru to present credentials; the Peruvian foreign ministry first dispatched a guard officer to Callao to receive him, then sent a train to Lima, and a vice-minister met him at the station.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yang Ru went to present credentials. Peru sent a guard officer to Callao, a train to Lima, and a vice-minister to the station.

sentences.zh: 遞書日又用宮車迎接。

translations.literal: On the day of presenting credentials a state carriage was again sent to receive him.
translations.idiomatic: On presentation day a state carriage was provided again.

sentences.zh: 公使遞國書，他國均用軍裝佩劍。

translations.literal: When ministers presented credentials, other countries used military uniform with swords.
translations.idiomatic: Other envoys presented credentials in military uniform with swords.

sentences.zh: 中國以秘系民主，沿例用行裝，行鞠躬禮，致頌詞，秘主答頌如禮。

translations.literal: Because Peru was a republic, China followed precedent in ordinary dress, performed the bow, delivered a congratulatory address, and the Peruvian president replied in kind.
translations.idiomatic: As Peru was a republic, the Chinese envoy wore ordinary dress, bowed, delivered congratulations, and received a formal reply.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，利馬華人在香港辦貨，秘駐港領事照驗加戳。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Chinese in Lima purchased goods in Hong Kong; the Peruvian consul in Hong Kong stamped the invoices for verification.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Lima Chinese bought goods in Hong Kong, and the Peruvian consul there stamped the invoices.

sentences.zh: 向例戳費值百抽一，至是增加，又改用金鎊，比前增逾倍。

translations.literal: By precedent the stamp fee was one percent of value; now it was increased and payment was changed to pounds sterling, more than doubling the former rate.
translations.idiomatic: The stamp fee had been one percent of value; it was now raised and collected in pounds sterling, more than doubling the old rate.

sentences.zh: 華商以秘違例，請秘外部飭知港領事照向例核收，又籥請于駐秘代辦謝希傅。

translations.literal: Merchants held that Peru had violated regulations and asked the foreign ministry to instruct the Hong Kong consul to collect according to precedent; they also petitioned Acting Minister Xie Xifu in Peru.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants protested the breach of rules and asked the foreign ministry and Acting Minister Xie Xifu to restore the old fee.

sentences.zh: 於是照會秘外部，謂：「貨單戳費向有定章，值百抽一，又為萬國通例。

translations.literal: A note was therefore sent to the foreign ministry stating: "The stamp fee on invoices has fixed regulations, one percent of value, which is also the universal practice.
translations.idiomatic: Xie therefore noted to the foreign ministry: "Invoice stamp fees are fixed at one percent worldwide.

sentences.zh: 貨本用金用銀，各國不一，而抽費皆按此為衡。

translations.literal: Whether capital is in gold or silver differs among countries, but the fee is always calculated on this basis.
translations.idiomatic: Capital may be gold or silver, but the one-percent rule applies everywhere.

sentences.zh: 即就利馬論，麥面一項由智利販運者，抽費俱按智洋，洋貨各項由英倫販運者，抽費俱按金錢，載在秘國稅則，眾所共知。

translations.literal: Even at Lima, wheat flour from Chile is charged on Chilean currency, and foreign goods from London on gold, as recorded in Peru's tariff and widely known.
translations.idiomatic: In Lima, Chilean flour duties use Chilean currency and British goods use gold, as Peru's tariff shows.

sentences.zh: 乃同一抽費，於智於英皆就地照抽，獨至香港一處忽示歧異，於理不解。

translations.literal: Yet the same fee is collected on the spot for Chile and Britain, while Hong Kong alone is treated differently—this is unreasonable.
translations.idiomatic: The same local rule applies to Chilean and British goods, yet Hong Kong alone is singled out.

sentences.zh: 或謂香港為英屬口岸，應改金鎊，則粵商貨本亦應升算金錢，方與通商各國一律，應請批示。」

translations.literal: If Hong Kong as British territory must use pounds, then Cantonese capital should also be converted to gold to match other treaty countries—this should be ordered."
translations.idiomatic: If Hong Kong must use pounds because it is British, Cantonese capital should be converted to gold like other treaty states."

sentences.zh: 秘外部不允批示。

translations.literal: The foreign ministry would not issue such an order.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign ministry refused.

sentences.zh: 旋稱港銀成色太低，換兌金鎊虧損過多。

translations.literal: It then said Hong Kong silver was too debased and conversion to pounds caused excessive loss.
translations.idiomatic: It claimed Hong Kong silver was debased and pound conversion too costly.

sentences.zh: 謝希傅告以一律改從金鎊，華商亦所甚原。

translations.literal: Xie Xifu reported that uniform collection in pounds would also satisfy the merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Xie reported that merchants would accept uniform pound fees.

sentences.zh: 秘外部始允收費按照貨本，一律改從金鎊。

translations.literal: The foreign ministry then agreed that fees would follow capital value and uniformly use pounds.
translations.idiomatic: Peru then agreed to charge on capital value in pounds sterling.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年五月，秘工党仇視駐秘利馬華人暴動，秘政府特頒苛例，令進口華人每名須有英金五百鎊呈驗，始得入口。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Xuantong, the Peruvian Civil Party, hostile to Chinese residents in Lima, rioted; the Peruvian government then issued harsh regulations requiring every Chinese immigrant to present proof of five hundred pounds sterling before entry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Xuantong, anti-Chinese riots by the Civil Party in Lima led Peru to require five hundred pounds sterling proof for every Chinese immigrant.

sentences.zh: 時出使美日秘大臣伍廷芳赴秘與交涉，先謁總統遞國書，即照會秘外部，謂秘所設苛例，違反兩國所立條約。

translations.literal: At the time Wu Tingfang, minister plenipotentiary to the United States, Japan, and Peru, went to Peru to negotiate; he first paid his respects to the president and presented his letter of credence, then addressed a note to the Peruvian foreign ministry stating that the harsh regulations violated the treaty between the two countries.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Wu Tingfang went to Lima, presented his credentials to the president, and notified the foreign ministry that the new rules breached the treaty.

sentences.zh: 旋復見秘總統辨論，請廢止飭諭。

translations.literal: He soon saw the Peruvian president again to argue the case and requested repeal of the decree.
translations.idiomatic: He argued again before the president and asked that the decree be withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 總統不允。

translations.literal: The president would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The president refused.

sentences.zh: 已復由秘外部覆文。

translations.literal: A reply then came from the foreign ministry.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign ministry replied in writing.

sentences.zh: 秘外部大臣玻立士謂廷芳，請先妥議限制中國工人出口來秘善法，附入條約。

translations.literal: Foreign Minister Porley told Tingfang to negotiate first a sound method of limiting Chinese laborers leaving China for Peru and attach it to the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign Minister Porley asked Wu to negotiate limits on Chinese labor emigration and attach them to the treaty.

sentences.zh: 廷芳答以章程不應附入條約。

translations.literal: Tingfang replied that regulations should not be attached to the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Wu replied that such regulations did not belong in the treaty.

sentences.zh: 玻立士又欲使秘領事有察驗華官所給護照是否合例之權，及到秘時，仍由地方官查驗，方准登岸。

translations.literal: Porley further wished Peruvian consuls to have the power to inspect whether passports issued by Chinese officials conformed to regulations, and that on arrival in Peru local officials should still inspect them before landing was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Porley also wanted Peruvian consuls to verify Chinese passports and local officials to inspect arrivals before permitting landing.

sentences.zh: 廷芳駁之，執不允。

translations.literal: Tingfang rebutted this and firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: Wu rejected the proposal and held firm.

sentences.zh: 廷芳閱草案，又請加「寓智利、厄瓜多、巴拿馬等處華商欲來秘者，可由代理中國領事等官發給護照，以為入境憑據」等語，玻立士允諾。

translations.literal: Reviewing the draft, Tingfang asked to add language that "Chinese merchants residing in Chile, Ecuador, Panama, and other places who wish to come to Peru may be issued passports by acting Chinese consular officials as credentials for entry," and Porley agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing the draft, Wu asked to add language that "Chinese merchants residing in Chile, Ecuador, Panama, and other places who wish to come to Peru may be issued passports by acting Chinese consular officials as credentials for entry," and Porley agreed.

sentences.zh: 時留秘華人多吸食鴉片，廷芳請秘贊助設法限制，秘總統許之。

translations.literal: At the time many Chinese residents in Peru smoked opium; Tingfang asked Peru to assist in devising restrictions, and the president agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Because many Chinese in Peru used opium, Wu asked for Peruvian help in restricting it, and the president consented.

sentences.zh: 旋復定議，廷芳與秘外部立廢除苛例證明書九條：一，中國允自限工人來秘；

translations.literal: Agreement was soon reached, and Tingfang and the foreign ministry drew up a nine-article certificate abolishing the harsh regulations: first, China agreed to limit laborers coming to Peru;
translations.idiomatic: They then signed a nine-article certificate abolishing the harsh rules: first, China would limit labor emigration to Peru;

sentences.zh: 二至六，定非作工之華人往秘護照辦法；

translations.literal: articles two through six fixed passport procedures for Chinese not coming as laborers;
translations.idiomatic: articles two through six set passport rules for non-labor immigrants;

sentences.zh: 七，定非作工者概不限制；

translations.literal: seventh, non-laborers were not restricted at all;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, non-laborers were unrestricted;

sentences.zh: 八，定免請護照者之資格；

translations.literal: eighth, qualifications for those exempt from applying for passports were fixed;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, exemptions from passport requirements were defined;

sentences.zh: 九，發照驗照祗須繳費五圓。

translations.literal: ninth, issuing and inspecting passports required only a fee of five dollars.
translations.idiomatic: ninth, passport issuance and inspection required only a five-dollar fee.

sentences.zh: 並停止秘國五月十四號頒發飭諭之效力。

translations.literal: The decree issued by Peru on the fourteenth day of the fifth month was also suspended in effect.
translations.idiomatic: Peru's decree of the fourteenth day of the fifth month was annulled.

sentences.zh: 時宣統元年七月十三日，即西曆一千九百零九年八月二十號。

translations.literal: The date was the thirteenth day of the seventh month of the first year of Xuantong, that is, the twentieth day of August, 1909 by the Western calendar.
translations.idiomatic: The date was the thirteenth day of the seventh month of the first year of Xuantong—20 August 1909 in the Western calendar.

sentences.zh: 署押蓋印。

translations.literal: It was signed, sealed, and stamped.
translations.idiomatic: It was signed and sealed.

sentences.zh: 巴西國，南亞美利加洲共和民主新國也，

translations.literal: Brazil is a new republic in South America.
translations.idiomatic: Brazil was a new republic in South America.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，始遣使臣喀拉多來天津，請議立和約。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu, an envoy, Carrado, was first dispatched to Tianjin to request negotiation of a treaty of peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu, Envoy Carrado first came to Tianjin to negotiate a treaty.

sentences.zh: 總署請飭南北洋大臣就近商辦。

translations.literal: The Yamen requested the northern and southern trade ministers to negotiate nearby.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen asked the northern and southern trade ministers to negotiate locally.

sentences.zh: 旋派李鴻章為全權大臣與議約。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was soon appointed plenipotentiary to conclude the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was appointed plenipotentiary.

sentences.zh: 六月一日，喀使抵天津，照會鴻章請立約，並擬先送約稿呈閱。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month the Brazilian envoy arrived at Tianjin, notified Hongzhang requesting a treaty, and proposed first submitting a draft for review.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month Carrado reached Tianjin, asked Li to negotiate, and offered a draft treaty.

sentences.zh: 遂訂期接議，研商至再始定約。

translations.literal: A date was set for talks; after repeated deliberation the treaty was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Talks were scheduled and, after repeated revision, the treaty was settled.

sentences.zh: 鴻章因上奏，言：「此次巴西議約，數易其稿。

translations.literal: Hongzhang memorialized the throne, stating: "This Brazilian negotiation changed drafts many times.
translations.idiomatic: Li memorialized: "The Brazilian negotiations required many drafts.

sentences.zh: 嗣以秘魯條約為底本，刪去招工各條，並參用別國條約，定為十六款。

translations.literal: Later the Peruvian treaty was used as a base, labor-recruitment articles deleted, and other countries' treaties consulted, fixing sixteen articles.
translations.idiomatic: The Peruvian treaty became the base, recruitment clauses were removed, and sixteen articles were settled.

sentences.zh: 其關係中國權利者，皆力為辯論，變通酌定。

translations.literal: All matters affecting China's rights were vigorously argued and adjusted.
translations.idiomatic: Every clause affecting Chinese rights was argued and revised.

sentences.zh: 如第一款『兩國人彼此皆可前往僑居』句下，添入『須由本人自原』一語，即寓禁阻設法招致之弊。

translations.literal: For example under Article 1, "nationals of both countries may go to reside in the other," was added "must be of their own free will," embodying prohibition of deceptive recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Article 1's "may reside in the other country" gained "of their own free will," barring coerced recruitment.

sentences.zh: 第三款『設立領事官，必須奉到駐紮之國批准文憑，方得視事，如辦事不合，可將批准文憑追回』，本系西國通例。

translations.literal: Article 3 on consuls "must present credentials approved by the receiving state before assuming office; if conduct is improper, credentials may be withdrawn" follows Western practice.
translations.idiomatic: Article 3 required approved consular credentials and allowed withdrawal—standard Western practice.

sentences.zh: 其立法之善有二：一則其人或非平素公正，或與我國向不浹洽，我皆可以不准；

translations.literal: The legislation has two merits: first, if a person is not ordinarily fair or has not been on good terms with us, we may refuse;
translations.idiomatic: This had two advantages: China could refuse unsuitable nominees;

sentences.zh: 一則通商口岸或系新設，人情未安，不欲領事驟至，我亦可以不准。

translations.literal: second, at a newly opened port where the populace is uneasy and consuls are not yet desired, we may also refuse.
translations.idiomatic: and could refuse consuls at newly opened ports where locals were uneasy.

sentences.zh: 至辦事不合，追回文憑，是予奪之權我亦得而操之。

translations.literal: When conduct is improper and credentials are withdrawn, the power of grant and recall remains in our hands.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawal of credentials kept grant and recall in Chinese hands.

sentences.zh: 第四款遊歷執照一節，洋人遊歷各處，多有由領事自填執照，送請關道用印，幾若內地往來，全憑領事作主。

translations.literal: On travel permits in Article 4, foreigners touring the interior often had consuls fill out permits for circuit intendants to stamp, nearly as if inland travel depended entirely on consuls.
translations.idiomatic: Article 4 addressed travel permits, which consuls had often issued for intendants merely to stamp.

sentences.zh: 今改為『領事照會關道，請領印照』，可稍助地方官之權。

translations.literal: This is changed to "the consul notifies the intendant, who issues the stamped permit," which can somewhat strengthen local officials' authority.
translations.idiomatic: Now consuls must ask intendants to issue stamped permits, strengthening local authority.

sentences.zh: 第五款遵守專章一節，即是德國新約第一款之義。

translations.literal: Article 5 on observing special articles is the meaning of Article 1 of the new German treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Article 5 on special clauses followed the new German treaty.

sentences.zh: 查『均霑』二字，利在洋人，害在中土，設法防弊，實為要圖。

translations.literal: The words "enjoy equally" benefit foreigners and harm China; preventing abuses is essential.
translations.idiomatic: The phrase "enjoy equally" favored foreigners; preventing abuse was essential.

sentences.zh: 特聲明嗣後如有優待他國利益，彼此須將互相酬報之專條或互訂之專章，一體遵守，方准同霑優待他國之利益，似較周妥。

translations.literal: It is specially declared that hereafter if another country is given preferential treatment, reciprocal special articles or agreements must be observed before the same benefit is granted—seemingly more thorough.
translations.idiomatic: Future preferences would require reciprocal special agreements before Brazil could claim them.

sentences.zh: 第六款本擬照德國新約，酌用漏報捏報辦法。

translations.literal: Article 6 was originally to follow the German treaty on under- and mis-reporting.
translations.idiomatic: Article 6 was to follow German rules on false declarations.

sentences.zh: 惟巴約系仿秘魯約本，並無通商詳細章程。

translations.literal: But the Brazilian treaty copied Peru's text and lacked detailed commercial regulations.
translations.idiomatic: But the Brazilian draft followed Peru and lacked detailed commercial rules.

sentences.zh: 若僅添漏報捏報一層，轉恐挂一漏萬。

translations.literal: Adding only under- and mis-reporting might leave other matters uncovered.
translations.idiomatic: A single clause on mis-reporting would leave gaps.

sentences.zh: 今定為『兩國商人商船，凡在此國通商口岸，即應遵從此國與各國原議續議通行商務章程辦理』。

translations.literal: It is now fixed that "merchants and vessels of both countries at the other's treaty ports shall follow that country's commercial regulations with all countries, original and supplementary."
translations.idiomatic: Merchants and ships must instead follow China's general commercial regulations with all powers.

sentences.zh: 第九、第十、第十一、第十二等款，皆指問案之事。

translations.literal: Articles 9, 10, 11, and 12 all concern trial of cases.
translations.idiomatic: Articles 9 through 12 concerned judicial cases.

sentences.zh: 查西國案件，俱由地方官訊斷，領事不得干預。

translations.literal: In Western countries cases are tried by local officials without consular interference.
translations.idiomatic: In the West local officials tried cases without consuls.

sentences.zh: 惟中西法律懸殊，各國不能聽地方官審辦，於是領事遂有其權。

translations.literal: Because Chinese and Western law differ greatly, foreign countries would not let local officials judge, and consuls gained authority.
translations.idiomatic: Legal differences had given consuls authority in China.

sentences.zh: 此次定為『被告所屬之官員專司訊斷，各依本國律例定罪』。

translations.literal: This time it is fixed that "the official of the defendant's nationality shall conduct the trial and sentence according to his own country's law."
translations.idiomatic: Now "the official of the defendant's nationality shall try and sentence under his own law."

sentences.zh: 蓋被告多系華民，前因會審掣肘，受虧不少。

translations.literal: Because defendants are mostly Chinese, joint trial had caused many losses.
translations.idiomatic: As defendants were mostly Chinese, joint trial had harmed them.

sentences.zh: 茲由被告所屬之官訊斷，當可持平辦理。

translations.literal: Now trial by the defendant's own official should be fairer.
translations.idiomatic: Trial by the defendant's own officials should be fairer.

sentences.zh: 又第十一款內『將來另議中西交涉公律，巴西亦應照辦』一節，雖公律驟難定議，究為洋務緊要關鍵，特倡其說，以作權輿。

translations.literal: Article 11 also states "when Sino-Western public law is negotiated hereafter, Brazil shall follow"—though public law cannot be settled quickly, it is a key point in foreign affairs and was proposed as a beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Article 11 also promised Brazil would follow any future Sino-Western code of law—a pioneering clause.

sentences.zh: 以上各節，皆按照各國約章酌議變通，期歸妥善。

translations.literal: All the above were negotiated with reference to various treaties and adjusted for soundness.
translations.idiomatic: All clauses were adjusted with reference to other treaties.

sentences.zh: 至洋藥一項，雖非巴西出產，惟中土受害滋深。

translations.literal: As for opium, though not produced in Brazil, China suffers deeply from it.
translations.idiomatic: Opium, though not Brazilian, deeply harmed China.

sentences.zh: 今議令巴使知會巴國外部查酌，禁止巴商販賣，先由巴使另備照會存案，臣亦給予照覆。」

translations.literal: The Brazilian envoy is now instructed to notify his foreign ministry to consider prohibiting Brazilian merchants from selling it; the envoy will first prepare a separate note for the record, and a reply note will be given."
translations.idiomatic: Brazil's envoy would notify his government to ban Brazilian opium sales, with exchange of notes."

sentences.zh: 約既訂，遂於八月初一日會同畫押鈐印。

translations.literal: After the treaty was settled, on the first day of the eighth month the parties jointly signed and sealed.
translations.idiomatic: The treaty was signed and sealed on the first day of the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，喀拉多忽詣李鴻章，謂接本國電報，復請商改。

translations.literal: In the third month of the following year Carrado suddenly called on Li Hongzhang, saying he had received a telegram from his country requesting further revision.
translations.idiomatic: Next year Carrado suddenly asked Li to revise the treaty by telegram from home.

sentences.zh: 於是增刪巴西原約共十七款，前約正副本作廢。

translations.literal: The original Brazilian treaty was then increased and reduced to seventeen articles; the former original and duplicate texts were voided.
translations.idiomatic: The treaty was revised to seventeen articles and the old texts voided.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，換約於上海。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year the treaty was exchanged at Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Instruments were exchanged at Shanghai in the fourth month of the eighth year.

sentences.zh: 八月，巴西贈鴻章寶星，旋答之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Brazil presented Hongzhang with a decoration, which was reciprocated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Brazil gave Li a decoration, which he reciprocated.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，巴西使臣貝雷拉請與中國立公斷專約。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, Brazilian Minister Berreira requested a special arbitration treaty with China.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 (1909) Brazilian Minister Berreira sought a special arbitration treaty.

sentences.zh: 先是巴使詣外務部，援照保和會公約，請與中國商訂一公斷條約，並呈所擬洋文約稿。

translations.literal: Earlier the Brazilian envoy had called on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, citing the Hague Convention, requesting negotiation of an arbitration treaty and presenting a draft in a foreign language.
translations.idiomatic: He had cited the Hague Convention and submitted a draft at the foreign ministry.

sentences.zh: 遂派外務部左侍郎聯芳為全權大臣，與貝雷拉議約四條：一，兩國外交官不能和平了結之案，可向海牙所設之常川公斷衙門投控，並請審斷，但須無礙兩國利益及國權榮譽，亦不得干涉第三國之利益；

translations.literal: Lian Fang, vice-president of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was appointed plenipotentiary to negotiate four articles with Berreira: first, cases that diplomats cannot settle peacefully may be submitted to the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague for judgment, provided this does not harm either country's interests or national honor and does not interfere with a third country's interests;
translations.idiomatic: Vice-President Lian Fang negotiated four articles: disputes unresolved diplomatically could go to the Hague court, without harming sovereignty or third parties;

sentences.zh: 二，公斷員之許可權及細則，須臨時由中國皇帝及巴西總統斟酌合宜辦法；

translations.literal: second, the arbitrators' authority and detailed rules shall be determined provisionally by the Chinese emperor and the Brazilian president as appropriate;
translations.idiomatic: arbitrators' powers would be set by both governments;

sentences.zh: 三，次約以五年為限，限滿六閱月未聲明作廢者，作為續訂五年，嗣後期限照此計算；

translations.literal: third, the supplementary treaty is for five years; if neither side declares void six months before expiry, it renews for five years, and later terms are calculated likewise;
translations.idiomatic: the treaty ran five years with automatic renewal unless denounced six months early;

sentences.zh: 四，本約批准後，在巴西京城換約，用華文、葡文、法文三體，而遇礙難解釋之處，則以法文為憑。

translations.literal: fourth, after ratification the treaty shall be exchanged in the Brazilian capital in Chinese, Portuguese, and French, and where interpretation is difficult French shall prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, after the treaty was ratified, the instruments would be exchanged in the Brazilian capital in Chinese, Portuguese, and French, with French controlling wherever interpretation was difficult;

sentences.zh: 此約畫押後，因事羈延，未及互換。

translations.literal: After this treaty was signed, affairs delayed exchange.
translations.idiomatic: signing was followed by delay in exchange.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，駐法代辦使事戴陳霖與巴西駐法代辦達旒格芬始在巴黎互換。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year Acting Minister Dai Chenlin and Brazilian Acting Minister Daglasfen exchanged at Paris.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 3 Dai Chenlin and Brazil's acting minister exchanged at Paris.

sentences.zh: 葡萄牙在歐羅巴極西。

translations.literal: Portugal lies at the extreme west of Europe.
translations.idiomatic: Portugal lies at the far west of Europe.

sentences.zh: 明正德年初至中國舟山、寧波、泉州。

translations.literal: In the early Zhengde years of the Ming it reached Zhoushan, Ningbo, and Quanzhou in China.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming Zhengde emperor it reached Zhoushan, Ningbo, and Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，至廣東香山縣濠鏡請隙地建屋，歲納租銀五百兩，實為歐羅巴通市粵東之始。

translations.literal: In the early Longqing period it came to Haojing in Xiangshan county, Guangdong, requesting a plot to build houses and paying five hundred taels rent annually—truly the beginning of European trade in eastern Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing it obtained Macao (Haojing), paying 500 taels annual rent—the start of European trade in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 清雍正五年夏四月，葡國遣使臣麥德樂表貢方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the fifth year of Yongzheng of the Qing, Portugal sent Minister Medeiros to present tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer fourth month of the fifth year of Yongzheng Portugal sent Minister Medeiros with tribute.

sentences.zh: 抵粵，巡撫楊文乾遣員伴送至京，召見賜宴。

translations.literal: Arriving in Guangdong, Governor Yang Wenqian dispatched an officer to escort him to the capital; he was received in audience and granted a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yang Wenqian escorted him to Beijing for audience and banquet.

sentences.zh: 於賞賚外，特賜人葠、緞匹、瓷漆器、紙墨、字畫、絹鐙、扇、香囊諸珍，加賞使臣，命御史常保住伴送至澳，遣歸國。

translations.literal: Besides the usual gifts, ginseng, satin, porcelain, lacquer, paper, ink, paintings, lanterns, fans, and sachets were specially granted; the envoy received additional rewards, and Censor Chang Baozhu was ordered to escort him to Macao for return.
translations.idiomatic: Extra gifts of ginseng, silk, porcelain, and art were granted; Censor Chang Baozhu escorted him back to Macao.

sentences.zh: 麥德樂在澳天主堂，率洋商誦經行禮，恭祝聖壽。

translations.literal: At the Catholic church in Macao Medeiros led foreign merchants in chanting scriptures and rituals to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: At Macao's Catholic church Medeiros led merchants in a birthday service for the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年夏四月，葡國遣使巴哲格、伯里多瑪諾入貢奉表，言：「臣父昔年仰奉聖主聖祖皇帝、世宗皇帝備極誠敬。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong, in the fourth month of summer Portugal sent envoys Pacheco and Primor to present tribute, stating: "My father in former years served the sacred sovereigns Kangxi and Yongzheng with utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong, Later Portugal sent Pacheco and Primor with tribute: "My father served Kangxi and Yongzheng with utmost loyalty.

sentences.zh: 臣父即世，臣嗣服以來，纘承父志，敬效虔恭。

translations.literal: When my father died I succeeded and have continued my father's will with reverent devotion.
