translations.idiomatic: Since his death I have continued his reverent service.

sentences.zh: 臣聞寓居中國西洋人等，仰蒙聖主施恩優眷，積有年所，臣不勝感激歡忭，謹遣一介使臣以申誠敬，因遣使巴哲格等代臣恭請聖主萬安，並行慶賀。

translations.literal: I hear that Westerners residing in China have long enjoyed the sacred sovereign's gracious favor; I am deeply grateful and joyful, and send an envoy to express sincerity, dispatching Pacheco and others to ask after the sacred sovereign's health and offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Westerners in China enjoy the Emperor's grace; I send Pacheco to wish His Majesty health and offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 伏乞聖主自天施降諸福，以惠小邦。

translations.literal: I humbly beg the sacred sovereign to bestow blessings from Heaven on our small state.
translations.idiomatic: May Heaven bless our small kingdom through the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 至寓居中國西洋人等，更乞鴻慈優待。

translations.literal: As for Westerners residing in China, I further beg gracious favor.
translations.idiomatic: I beg continued favor for Western residents in China.

sentences.zh: 再所遣使臣明白自愛，臣國諸務俱令料理，臣遣其至京，必能慰悅聖懷。

translations.literal: The envoy I send is prudent and self-respecting; I have ordered all affairs of my country managed so that his arrival in the capital will surely please the sacred mind.
translations.idiomatic: My envoy is prudent; affairs at home are arranged so his arrival will please the throne.

sentences.zh: 凡所陳奏，伏祈採納。」

translations.literal: All I present, I humbly beg be accepted."
translations.idiomatic: I humbly beg acceptance of all I present."

sentences.zh: 道光二十九年，其酋啞嗎勒為澳民所殺，藉端尋釁，釘關逐役，抗不交租，又屯兵建台，編牌勒稅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang its chief Amaral was killed by Macao residents; seizing the pretext to pick a quarrel, Portugal barred the passes, expelled the customs staff, refused to pay rent, garrisoned troops, built forts, registered households, and imposed levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang Governor Amaral was killed by Macao residents; Portugal then barred the barrier gates, expelled Chinese officials, withheld rent, garrisoned troops, built batteries, registered households, and imposed new taxes.

sentences.zh: 於是澳地關閘以內，悉被侵佔，粵省大吏置之不問。

translations.literal: Thereupon all territory within the Macao barrier gates was occupied, and the high officials of Guangdong paid no heed.
translations.idiomatic: All land within the Macao barrier gates was thus seized, while Guangdong's governors looked the other way.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年冬十月，葡萄牙遣人來上海請立約。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter of the eighth year of Xianfeng Portugal sent men to Shanghai to request the conclusion of a treaty.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month of the eighth year of Xianfeng Portugal asked to negotiate a treaty at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 時欽差大臣大學士桂良駐滬，初拒之。

translations.literal: At the time Imperial Commissioner and Grand Secretary Guiliang was stationed at Shanghai and at first refused.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Commissioner Guiliang, then in Shanghai, initially refused.

sentences.zh: 旋為奏聞，未許。

translations.literal: The matter was soon reported to the throne, and permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized the court, which did not approve.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，葡人欲在澳門設立領事，粵督張樹森不允，欲令駐香港領事兼辦。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu the Portuguese wished to establish a consul at Macao; Governor-General Zhang Shusen of Guangdong did not agree and wished to have the consul resident in Hong Kong handle the matter concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Guangxu Portugal sought a consul at Macao; Governor-General Zhang Shusen refused and proposed that the Hong Kong consul handle Macao as well.

sentences.zh: 出使大臣曾紀澤謂：「葡人之於澳門，儼然據為己有，唯租住之名尚存。

translations.literal: Minister Plenipotentiary Zeng Jize said: "As for the Portuguese in Macao, they already hold it as their own in all but name; only the title of lease still remains.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Zeng Jize argued: "Portugal already treats Macao as its own; only the fiction of leasehold remains.

sentences.zh: 若忽令香港領事兼理，將借香港領事之名，引為澳門領事之據。

translations.literal: If the Hong Kong consul were suddenly ordered to handle Macao concurrently, they would use the name of the Hong Kong consul as grounds for a Macao consul.
translations.idiomatic: If the Hong Kong consul were suddenly given Macao as well, Portugal would cite that post as precedent for a Macao consul.

sentences.zh: 查澳門本有縣丞等官，似宜仿上海租界之例，設立官職較崇委員，並令督同縣丞辦理交涉事件，庶幾可圖補救。」

translations.literal: Since Macao already has an assistant magistrate and other officials, it would seem fitting to follow the precedent of the Shanghai concessions, appoint a commissioner of somewhat higher rank, and order him to supervise the assistant magistrate in handling matters of negotiation, so that some remedy might be sought."
translations.idiomatic: Macao already has an assistant magistrate and other officials; Beijing should follow the Shanghai concession model, appoint a senior commissioner, and have him supervise the assistant magistrate in negotiations—only thus might the situation be salvaged."

sentences.zh: 十二年，政府因開辦洋藥稅釐並徵新章，總署奏請飭派邵友濂，會同總稅務司赫德，前往香港會商辦法。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the government, instituting opium likin and new regulations, memorialized the Yamen to dispatch Shao Youlian together with Inspector General Hart to Hong Kong to consult on methods.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, with new opium taxes, Shao Youlian and Hart were sent to Hong Kong to consult.

sentences.zh: 查知洋藥自印度來華，香港為總匯之區，必須英、葡兩國一律會辦，始能得力。

translations.literal: Investigation showed opium came from India to China with Hong Kong as the main entrepôt; British and Portuguese cooperation was essential for effectiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Opium from India passed through Hong Kong; British and Portuguese cooperation was essential.

sentences.zh: 因與澳門總督商緝私辦法。

translations.literal: Methods to suppress smuggling were therefore discussed with the governor of Macao.
translations.idiomatic: Anti-smuggling methods were discussed with the Macao governor.

sentences.zh: 又恐葡為無約之國，遽與商辦，或多要求。

translations.literal: Because Portugal had no treaty, immediate negotiation might lead to excessive demands.
translations.idiomatic: As Portugal had no treaty, direct talks might invite excessive demands.

sentences.zh: 於是遣赫德與之電商，擬設稅務司，澳督亦允。

translations.literal: Hart was therefore sent to negotiate by telegram; a customs office was proposed and the Macao governor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Hart negotiated by wire; Macao agreed to a customs post.

sentences.zh: 乃訂草約四條：一，兩國在京互換通商條約；

translations.literal: A draft of four articles was then drawn up: first, the two countries exchange commercial treaties in Beijing;
translations.idiomatic: A four-article draft followed: exchange of commercial treaties in Beijing;

sentences.zh: 一，中國准葡國永駐管理澳門；

translations.literal: second, China permits Portugal permanently to administer Macao;
translations.idiomatic: second, China recognizes Portuguese administration of Macao;

sentences.zh: 一，葡國允非中國則澳地不讓與他國；

translations.literal: One: Portugal agrees that Macao territory shall not be ceded to other countries unless China [consents];
translations.idiomatic: First, Portugal agreed that Macao would not be transferred to any other country without China's consent;

sentences.zh: 一，洋藥稅徵香港如何，會同澳門即類推辦理。

translations.literal: Two: as for how the opium tax is levied in Hong Kong, Macao shall handle it by analogous application in concert.
translations.idiomatic: Second, whatever arrangements applied to the opium tax in Hong Kong would be extended to Macao by analogy.

sentences.zh: 當派稅務司金登幹在葡國畫押，並允其派使來華，擬議詳細條約。

translations.literal: Thereupon Revenue Inspector Campbell was dispatched to Portugal to affix his signature, and permission was granted for Portugal to send an envoy to China to negotiate a detailed treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Campbell, an official of the Revenue Service, was sent to Portugal to sign the agreement, and Portugal was permitted to dispatch a minister to China to negotiate the detailed treaty.

sentences.zh: 粵督張之洞上疏，言：「澳門為香山縣管轄，距省城二百餘里，陸路可通，實為廣東濱海門戶，非如瓊州之孤懸海外，亦非如香港之矗立海中。

translations.literal: The Governor-General of Guangdong Zhang Zhidong submitted a memorial, stating: "Macao is under the jurisdiction of Xiangshan County, over two hundred li from the provincial capital, accessible by land—it is truly Guangdong's coastal gateway, unlike Qiongzhou isolated overseas, and unlike Hong Kong standing alone in the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong, Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi, submitted a memorial in which he said: "Macao falls under the jurisdiction of Xiangshan County. More than two hundred li from the provincial capital and reachable by land, it is in truth Guangdong's gateway on the coast—not like Qiongzhou, marooned across the sea, nor like Hong Kong, standing alone in the open water.

sentences.zh: 葡人今因事要求，曲徇其請，遷就立約，實多可慮。

translations.literal: The Portuguese now make demands on account of the matter; bending to their requests and accommodating them in concluding a treaty—this gives much cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese were now pressing demands on this account. To yield to their wishes and settle for a treaty on their terms would invite serious trouble.

sentences.zh: 挽回補救之策，約有五條：一曰細訂詳約。

translations.literal: Strategies for recovery and remedy, approximately five in number: the first is to draft a detailed treaty carefully.
translations.idiomatic: Measures to repair the damage and set things right might be summed up in five points. First: negotiate a thorough detailed treaty.

sentences.zh: 查簡約雖經金登幹畫押，而詳細條約應刪應增，仍須俟葡使到華，會同總署核議，請旨辦理。

translations.literal: Investigating: although the brief treaty was signed by Campbell, what in the detailed treaty should be deleted or added still requires awaiting the arrival of the Portuguese envoy in China, to be examined and discussed jointly with the Zongli Yamen, and handled upon imperial instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Although Campbell had signed the preliminary agreement, additions and deletions to the full treaty must still await the arrival of the Portuguese minister in China, to be reviewed jointly with the Zongli Yamen and submitted for imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 其永駐澳門一條，原因協辦藥徵，格外見讓租銀，非畫地歸葡者可比。

translations.literal: The clause on permanent residence in Macao—its reason was to assist in collecting the opium levy, with extraordinary concession on rental silver—it cannot be compared to ceding territory to Portugal.
translations.idiomatic: The provision allowing Portugal to remain permanently in Macao stemmed from their cooperation in opium tax collection and an exceptional waiver of rent—it was nothing like ceding territory outright to Portugal.

sentences.zh: 且約有『不得轉讓他國』之文，可見澳門系中國疆土，讓與葡國居住，應聲明葡國居住免其租銀，不得視為葡國屬地。

translations.literal: Moreover the treaty contains language of "shall not be transferred to other countries," which shows Macao is Chinese territory; granting Portugal residence should be declared as Portugal residing with rent waived—not regarded as Portuguese territory.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the treaty already included wording that Macao "shall not be transferred to other countries"—showing it remained Chinese soil. The concession to Portugal should be framed as permission to reside there with rent exempted, not as Portuguese sovereign territory.

sentences.zh: 其不讓於他國一條，應聲明澳門系中國疆土，葡國不得讓於他國。

translations.literal: The clause on not ceding to other countries should declare Macao is Chinese territory; Portugal may not cede to other countries.
translations.idiomatic: The non-transfer clause should explicitly state that Macao is Chinese territory which Portugal may not cede to any third power.

sentences.zh: 如此，則我有讓地之名，而無損權之實，仍與原約之義毫不相背。

translations.literal: Thus, though we have the name of ceding land, there is no reality of diminished sovereignty—still entirely consistent with the original treaty intent.
translations.idiomatic: In this way we would bear the appearance of cession while suffering no actual loss of authority—entirely consistent with the spirit of the original agreement.

sentences.zh: 一曰畫清界限。

translations.literal: Second: delineate boundaries clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Second: fix the boundaries clearly.

sentences.zh: 有陸界，有水界。

translations.literal: There are land boundaries and water boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: There are boundaries on land and at sea.

sentences.zh: 何謂陸界？

translations.literal: What is meant by land boundary?
translations.idiomatic: What is the land boundary?

sentences.zh: 東北枕山，西南濱海，是為澳門。

translations.literal: Northeast backed by mountains, southwest facing the sea—this is Macao.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains lie to the northeast and the sea to the southwest—that defines Macao.

sentences.zh: 其原立之三巴門、水坑門、新開門舊址，具在志乘可徵，所築砲台、馬路、兵房，均屬格外侵佔。

translations.literal: The former sites of the three gates—Barra Gate, Portas do Cerco, and Xingkai Gate—all attested in gazetteers; the forts, roads, and barracks built are all extraneous encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: The original locations of the Barra Gate, Portas do Cerco, and Xingkai Gate can all be verified in local gazetteers. The forts, roads, and barracks Portugal had built were all unlawful encroachment beyond what was permitted.

sentences.zh: 應于立約時堅持圍牆為界，不使尺寸有逾。

translations.literal: At treaty conclusion one should insist on the barrier wall as the boundary, not permitting the slightest excess.
translations.idiomatic: When the treaty was drawn up, the wall should be insisted on as the boundary, with not an inch conceded beyond it.

sentences.zh: 何謂水界？

translations.literal: What is meant by water boundary?
translations.idiomatic: What of the water boundary?

sentences.zh: 公法載地主有管轄水界之權，以砲子能及之處為止。

translations.literal: International law records that the landowner possesses jurisdiction over water boundaries, to the limit of where cannon shot can reach.
translations.idiomatic: International law holds that a territory's coastal jurisdiction extends as far as a cannon shot can carry.

sentences.zh: 兩國土地毗連，中隔小河，則以中流為界。

translations.literal: When two countries' lands adjoin with a small river between, the midstream is the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Where two nations' lands adjoin with a stream between them, the mid-channel is taken as the border.

sentences.zh: 此系指各國自有之地，及征伐所得者而言。

translations.literal: This refers to each country's own territory and what is obtained through conquest.
translations.idiomatic: That rule applies to each nation's own territory and lands acquired by force.

sentences.zh: 澳門本系中國之地，不過准其永遠居住，葡人只能管轄所住之地。

translations.literal: Macao is originally Chinese land; merely permitted permanent residence—the Portuguese can only exercise jurisdiction over where they reside.
translations.idiomatic: Macao was Chinese territory throughout; Portugal had merely been allowed to live there permanently and could govern only the ground they occupied.

sentences.zh: 宜明立條款，所有水道，准其船隻往來，不得援引公法，兼管水界。

translations.literal: It is appropriate to establish clear articles: on all waterways permit their vessels passage, but they must not invoke international law to also govern the water boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Clear provisions should be written stipulating that Portuguese vessels may pass freely on all waterways, but Portugal must not invoke international law to claim jurisdiction over adjacent waters as well.

sentences.zh: 一曰界由外定。

translations.literal: Third: the boundary should be fixed through external demarcation.
translations.idiomatic: Third: the border should be determined through joint field survey.

sentences.zh: 准葡住澳，免其租銀，水界仍是中國所有，自無水界之可分，陸界至舊有圍牆為止。

translations.literal: Permitting Portuguese residence in Macao with rent waived—water boundaries still belong to China, naturally there is no water boundary to divide; land boundary extends only to the old barrier wall.
translations.idiomatic: Granting Portugal the right to remain in Macao rent-free left all water jurisdiction in China's hands—there was no maritime border to negotiate. On land, the line should stop at the original barrier wall.

sentences.zh: 葡人于同治初年將圍牆拆卸，希圖滅跡。

translations.literal: The Portuguese in the early Tongzhi era demolished the barrier wall, hoping to erase the evidence.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Tongzhi period the Portuguese had torn down the barrier wall, hoping to erase all trace of it.

sentences.zh: 然牆可拆，而舊址終不可沒。

translations.literal: Yet though the wall can be demolished, the old site ultimately cannot be obliterated.
translations.idiomatic: The wall could be torn down, but its former location could never be wiped away.

sentences.zh: 將來約有成議，似應由粵省督撫臣就近派員會同葡使親往勘驗，詳查舊址，公同立界，俾免影射逾越。

translations.literal: When the treaty is agreed in future, it seems appropriate for the Guangdong governor-general and provincial governor to dispatch nearby officials jointly with the Portuguese envoy to inspect personally, examine the old sites in detail, and establish boundaries together, so as to prevent covert encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Once a treaty was finalized, officials should be dispatched from Guangdong to join the Portuguese envoy on a site inspection, verify the old boundaries, and mark the border jointly—preventing any surreptitious expansion.

sentences.zh: 一曰核對洋文。

translations.literal: Fourth: verify the foreign-language text.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: cross-check the foreign-language text.

sentences.zh: 查赫德申稱所訂草約四條，與澳門洋報所載者，文義輕重懸殊。

translations.literal: Investigation shows Hart reported that the four draft treaty articles signed differ greatly in weight of meaning from those published in Macao foreign newspapers.
translations.idiomatic: According to Hart's report, the four articles of the draft treaty differed drastically in tone and substance from versions published in Macao's foreign-language press.

sentences.zh: 第一條派使來華擬議通商條約，洋文內加『須有利益均霑』字樣。

translations.literal: The first article on dispatching an envoy to China to negotiate commercial treaties—in the foreign text was added the phrase "with benefits equally shared."
translations.idiomatic: The first article, on sending a minister to China to negotiate trade treaties, had been supplemented in the foreign text with the phrase "most-favored-nation treatment."

sentences.zh: 第二條葡國永駐澳門管理一切，洋文內加『悉與葡國別處屬地無異』字樣。

translations.literal: The second article on Portugal's permanent residence in Macao managing all affairs—in the foreign text was added "entirely no different from Portugal's other territorial possessions."
translations.idiomatic: The second article, granting Portugal permanent residence in Macao with full administrative authority, carried an added foreign-language phrase: "in all respects identical to Portugal's possessions elsewhere."

sentences.zh: 草約內澳門字樣凡三見，洋文皆作『澳門及澳門附地』。

translations.literal: Where "Macao" appears three times in the draft, the foreign text in every instance reads "Macao and Macao dependencies."
translations.idiomatic: In all three places where the draft mentioned Macao, the foreign text read "Macao and its dependencies."

sentences.zh: 查『附地』二字，意極含糊，不惟將圍牆外至望廈村陰括在內，即附近小島毗連村落，皆可作附地觀。

translations.literal: Investigating: the two characters "dependencies" are extremely vague—not only encompassing from outside the wall to Wangxia village and beyond, but nearby islets and adjacent villages could all be regarded as dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: The term "dependencies" was dangerously vague—sweeping in not only the area from beyond the wall to Wangxia village but potentially every nearby island and adjoining settlement.

sentences.zh: 至謂『與葡國別處屬地無異』一語，措詞亦謬。

translations.literal: As for saying "no different from Portugal's other territorial possessions"—the wording is also erroneous.
translations.idiomatic: The phrase comparing Macao to Portugal's other colonial possessions was equally outrageous.

sentences.zh: 雖洋報所載未盡可信，傳說必非無因。

translations.literal: Although what the foreign newspapers publish cannot entirely be trusted, rumors surely are not without cause.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign press accounts might not be fully reliable, but such reports did not arise from nothing.

sentences.zh: 既與總署奏案不符，亦非奉旨准其永駐之本意。

translations.literal: This both fails to accord with the Zongli Yamen's memorial to the throne and is not the original intent of the imperial order permitting permanent residence.
translations.idiomatic: This contradicted the Zongli Yamen's submitted report and fell far short of the imperial purpose in allowing permanent residence.

sentences.zh: 應請飭下總署，先將草約漢、洋文詳細核對，以防侵越。

translations.literal: It should be requested to instruct the Zongli Yamen first to verify the draft Chinese and foreign texts in detail, to guard against encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen should be instructed to undertake a thorough comparison of the Chinese and foreign-language drafts before proceeding, to forestall territorial encroachment.

sentences.zh: 一曰暫緩批准。

translations.literal: Fifth: temporarily defer ratification.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: withhold ratification for the time being.

sentences.zh: 立約雖有成議，批准權在朝廷，此各國之通例。

translations.literal: Though treaty conclusion may reach agreement, the power of ratification rests with the court—this is the common practice of all nations.
translations.idiomatic: Even after terms are agreed, ratification rests with the throne—as is customary among all nations.

sentences.zh: 美國煙臺條約，光緒二年所立，有未經批准三條，直至上年始行議定，成案可據。

translations.literal: The American Chefoo Treaty concluded in the second year of Guangxu had three articles not ratified, until last year finally settled—a precedent on record.
translations.idiomatic: The Chefoo Convention with the United States, concluded in 1876, left three articles unratified until the previous year—an established precedent.

sentences.zh: 自應明與之約，定約後，須俟稅釐款項大增、拐騙逃亡隨捉隨解諸事皆有明效可徵，兩國始行批准互換，庶彼不得終售其欺。」

translations.literal: Naturally one should explicitly agree with them: after the treaty is concluded, one must await greatly increased revenue from duties, and extradition of kidnappers and fugitives captured and returned as called for—all with clear evidence of effect—before the two countries ratify and exchange, so that they cannot ultimately sell their deception."
translations.idiomatic: Portugal should be told plainly that ratification and exchange would come only after measurable results—significantly increased tax revenue and prompt extradition of kidnappers and fugitives—so they could not perpetuate their deceptions indefinitely."

sentences.zh: 疏入，報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received and approved.

sentences.zh: 葡使羅沙旋來華詣總署呈節略及地圖。

translations.literal: The Portuguese minister Rosa soon came to China, presented at the Zongli Yamen a summary and maps.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister Rosa soon arrived in China and presented a brief and maps to the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 總署王大臣閱圖，與現在葡人所居之地界址不清，多所辯駁。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers of the Zongli Yamen reviewing the maps—the boundaries with Portuguese current residence unclear, much dispute arose.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen ministers examined the maps and found the boundaries of Portuguese occupation ill-defined, sparking considerable dispute.

sentences.zh: 復致北洋大臣李鴻章，派員赴澳確查。

translations.literal: A letter was also sent to Li Hongzhang, Beiyang Minister, to dispatch officials to Macao for thorough investigation.
translations.idiomatic: They also wrote to Li Hongzhang, Minister for the Northern Seas, asking him to send officials to Macao for an on-the-ground investigation.

sentences.zh: 張之洞復上疏，請先清界址，緩議條約。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong again submitted a memorial, requesting first to clarify boundaries and defer treaty negotiation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong submitted another memorial urging that boundaries be settled first and treaty talks postponed.

sentences.zh: 略謂：「澳門水陸一帶，大抵有葡人原租之界，有久占之界，有新占之界，有圖占未得之界。

translations.literal: Briefly stating: "In the Macao area by land and water, broadly speaking there are boundaries of original Portuguese lease, long-occupied boundaries, newly occupied boundaries, and boundaries plotted but not yet obtained.
translations.idiomatic: He argued in substance: "The Macao region, on land and sea alike, comprised originally leased territory, long-held encroachments, recent seizures, and areas claimed but not yet taken.

sentences.zh: 除原租之圍牆以內，仍舊聽其居住外，已占者明示限制，未占者力為劃清。」

translations.literal: Apart from within the barrier wall of the original lease, still permitting residence as before—what is already occupied should be clearly limited; what is not occupied should be strenuously delineated."
translations.idiomatic: Within the barrier wall of the original lease they might continue to reside as before, but encroached territory should be explicitly confined and unoccupied land firmly demarcated."

sentences.zh: 又謂：「洋藥來華，皆徑到香港，分運各口，從無徑運澳門之船。

translations.literal: He also stated: "Opium coming to China all goes directly to Hong Kong, distributed to various ports—never ships going directly to Macao.
translations.idiomatic: He further observed: "Opium entering China flows entirely through Hong Kong and is distributed from there to the various treaty ports—no vessel ever ships it directly to Macao.

sentences.zh: 是稽察之關鍵，在香港不在澳門」等語。

translations.literal: Thus the key to inspection is in Hong Kong, not Macao," and similar language.
translations.idiomatic: The critical point of enforcement lies with Hong Kong, not Macao."

sentences.zh: 總署因界址一時難清，仍主先議約、後劃界，久之始定。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen because boundaries were momentarily hard to clarify, still upheld first negotiating the treaty then delimiting—long afterward finally settled.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to settle boundaries promptly, the Zongli Yamen maintained its position of negotiating the treaty first and demarcating afterward—a resolution that took considerable time.

sentences.zh: 於是總署上言曰：「向者總署兩次商辦此事，一議通商訂約，一議給價收回，迄無成說。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Zongli Yamen reported to the throne: "Formerly the Yamen twice undertook negotiations on this matter—once discussing commercial treaty, once discussing purchase price to recover—all without final agreement.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen then reported: "The Yamen had twice before taken up this question—once to negotiate a commercial treaty, once to buy back the territory—and both efforts had failed to reach conclusion.

sentences.zh: 今因洋藥緝私一事，允其重申前議。

translations.literal: Now on account of the opium smuggling suppression matter, permitted them to reiterate the prior proposals.
translations.idiomatic: On account of the campaign against opium smuggling, they were now allowed to reopen their earlier proposals.

sentences.zh: 並以澳門地方界址一層，從先久經含混，因與葡使羅沙迭商，於約內言明澳門界址俟勘明再定，並聲明未經定界以前，不得有增減改變之事。

translations.literal: Also regarding Macao territorial boundaries—a layer long ambiguous—through repeated negotiations with Portuguese minister Rosa, within the treaty stated Macao boundaries await survey before fixation, and declared before boundaries are fixed no additions, subtractions, or alterations.
translations.idiomatic: Because Macao's boundaries had long been unclear, they negotiated repeatedly with Minister Rosa and stipulated in the treaty that Macao's borders would be fixed only after survey, and that no change in the existing situation would be permitted until demarcation was complete.

sentences.zh: 仍將不得讓與他國一層專立一條，永昭信守。

translations.literal: Still establishing a separate article on not ceding to other countries, to proclaim faith forever.
translations.idiomatic: A separate article prohibiting transfer to any third power was added as a permanent pledge.

sentences.zh: 葡使允即電達本國，照此定議。

translations.literal: The Portuguese minister agreed to immediately telegraph his country to settle according to this.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister agreed to cable his government immediately and settle on these terms.

sentences.zh: 正籌辦間，續接李鴻章函，稱粵省督撫臣分別原租、久占、新占、未占四層辦法。

translations.literal: Just while arrangements were underway, a further letter from Li Hongzhang arrived, stating the Guangdong governor-general and provincial governor's four-tier handling of original lease, long occupation, new occupation, and unoccupied.
translations.idiomatic: While preparations were underway, Li Hongzhang wrote again reporting the Guangdong authorities' four-tier scheme distinguishing original lease, long occupation, new occupation, and unoccupied areas.

sentences.zh: 所謂久占者，不知何年。

translations.literal: What is called long occupation—the year is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: The date of the so-called long occupation was uncertain.

sentences.zh: 新占者，亦在咸豐、同治以後。

translations.literal: New occupation also falls after the Xianfeng and Tongzhi periods.
translations.idiomatic: New encroachments dated to the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns or later.

sentences.zh: 委員程佐衡回津面與討論，查圍牆以內為原租，關閘以內皆所久占，譚仔、過路環則為新占。

translations.literal: Commissioner Cheng Zuohéng returned to Tianjin and discussed in person: investigating, within the barrier wall is original lease, within Portas do Cerco all is long occupied, Taipa and Coloane are new occupation.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Cheng Zuohéng returned to Tianjin and reported after discussion that the area within the barrier wall was the original lease, everything within Portas do Cerco had been long occupied, and Taipa and Coloane were recent seizures.

sentences.zh: 此皆已占者也。

translations.literal: These are all already occupied.
translations.idiomatic: All of these were territory already held.

sentences.zh: 關閘以北直達前山，澳西對岸灣子、銀坑各處，遠及東南各島，皆欲占而未占者也。

translations.literal: North of Portas do Cerco directly to Qianshan, across the water west of Macao at Wanzi, Yinkeng and other places, extending to southeastern isles—all desired occupation but not yet occupied.
translations.idiomatic: The strip north of Portas do Cerco reaching to Qianshan, the shores of Wanzi and Yinkeng across the channel west of Macao, and the islands far to the southeast—all were areas Portugal sought but had not yet taken.

sentences.zh: 應俟將來派員勘界時隨時斟酌辦理。」

translations.literal: Should await when officials are dispatched in future for boundary survey, to handle as circumstances warrant."
translations.idiomatic: These would be handled case by case when boundary commissioners were sent out."

sentences.zh: 尋報可。

translations.literal: Shortly approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approval followed shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 嗣因交犯一條，葡使欲照英約載明華人犯罪逃至澳門者，查明實系罪犯交出。

translations.literal: Subsequently because of the extradition article, the Portuguese minister wished following the English treaty to stipulate Chinese criminals fleeing to Macao—once verified as criminals, surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Later, on the extradition clause, the Portuguese minister sought wording modeled on the British treaty: Chinese criminals who fled to Macao would be handed over once their guilt was established.

sentences.zh: 總署不允。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen refused.

sentences.zh: 磋商久之，始允添改華民犯案逃往澳門，官員仍照向來辦法，查獲交出。

translations.literal: After long negotiation, finally agreed to add and revise: Chinese subjects committing crimes fleeing to Macao—officials still following established practice, upon investigation and capture, surrender.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged negotiation they agreed to revised language: when Chinese subjects who had committed crimes fled to Macao, officials would continue to handle matters as before—investigating, apprehending, and surrendering them.

sentences.zh: 又稽查洋藥一事，復於專約內添寫「所有澳門出口前往中國各海口之洋藥，必須由督理洋藥之洋員給發准照，一面由該洋員立將轉運出口之准照，轉致拱北關稅務司辦理」。

translations.literal: Also on the matter of inspecting opium, again added in the special treaty: "All opium exported from Macao to China's various ports must receive permits from the foreign official supervising opium; the said foreign official shall immediately forward the re-export permit to the Revenue Inspector of Gongbei Customhouse for handling."
translations.idiomatic: On opium inspection as well, the supplementary agreement added: "All opium exported from Macao to Chinese ports must carry a permit issued by the foreign superintendent of opium affairs, who shall promptly forward copies of export permits to the Revenue Inspector at Gongbei Customhouse."

sentences.zh: 遂定議。

translations.literal: Thereupon the matter was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The terms were then finalized.

sentences.zh: 共計條約五十四款，及緝私專約三款，當即劃押。

translations.literal: Total treaty fifty-four articles, and smuggling-suppression special treaty three articles—immediately signed.
translations.idiomatic: The treaty comprised fifty-four articles plus three supplementary articles on smuggling suppression, and both were signed forthwith.

sentences.zh: 是年葡人散鈔單于望廈，不納。

translations.literal: That year Portuguese distributed notices at Wangxia; refused.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Portuguese circulated proclamations at Wangxia, which were rejected.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，命李鴻章與葡使在天津換約，復公立換約文憑，華、洋文各一，畫押蓋印蕆事。

translations.literal: The following year third month, ordered Li Hongzhang and the Portuguese minister to exchange treaties at Tianjin; further jointly established treaty-exchange credentials, one Chinese and one foreign text each, signed and sealed to complete the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the following year Li Hongzhang was directed to exchange ratifications with the Portuguese minister at Tianjin. Exchange certificates in Chinese and Portuguese were also drawn up, signed, and sealed to conclude the matter.

sentences.zh: 是月葡人出關閘外設一路燈，又修復前山營廠卡，張之洞責令撤去。

translations.literal: That month Portuguese went outside Portas do Cerco to set up a street lamp, also restored Qianshan garrison checkpoint—Zhang Zhidong ordered removal.
translations.idiomatic: That same month the Portuguese erected a street lamp outside Portas do Cerco and rebuilt the Qianshan garrison checkpoint. Zhang Zhidong ordered both removed.

sentences.zh: 旋據澳酋照稱：「關閘外至北山嶺中間一帶，向為局外之區。

translations.literal: Shortly the Macao governor's note stated: "The strip from outside Portas do Cerco to between Beishan Ridge was always a neutral zone.
translations.idiomatic: The Macao governor soon replied in a note: "The stretch from beyond Portas do Cerco to Beishan Ridge had always been a neutral zone.

sentences.zh: 建廠須兩國會商，非一國所能擅主，已照會鈞署」云云。

translations.literal: Building installations requires both countries' consultation—not something one country can decide alone; already notified Your Excellency's office," and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: Construction in that area requires agreement between both governments; neither side may act unilaterally. We have already notified your office accordingly."

sentences.zh: 張之洞即致總署，謂：「條約載未定界以前，俱照依現時情形勿動，自系指澳境關閘以內彼所已占者而言。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong immediately wrote the Zongli Yamen, stating: "The treaty records before boundaries are fixed all follow present circumstances without change—this naturally refers to within Portas do Cerco in Macao territory where they have already occupied.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong wrote immediately to the Zongli Yamen: "The treaty's stipulation that the status quo should be maintained until boundaries were fixed clearly applied only to Portuguese-held territory within Portas do Cerco.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，葡使來京議約，亦言關閘以外系華官把守，未敢侵及，從無『局外』之說。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, the Portuguese minister came to the capital to negotiate—also stated outside Portas do Cerco was guarded by Chinese officials, dared not encroach, never any talk of "neutral zone."
translations.idiomatic: In 1862, when the Portuguese minister came to Beijing to negotiate, he acknowledged that Chinese officials held the area beyond Portas do Cerco and that Portugal had never encroached there—there was no such thing as a "neutral zone."

sentences.zh: 此次來文，實堪詫異，請折辯。」

translations.literal: This incoming document is truly astonishing—please rebut."
translations.idiomatic: This latest communication was outrageous. Please issue a firm rebuttal."

sentences.zh: 五月，葡人又欲爭執舵尾山管轄權。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Portuguese again wished to dispute jurisdiction over Duoweishan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Portuguese raised a dispute over jurisdiction of Duoweishan.

sentences.zh: 張之洞致總署，謂：「舵尾山在十字門小橫琴島上，為香山縣屬，向無葡人居此。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong wrote the Zongli Yamen, stating: "Duoweishan is on Xiahengqin Island in Shizimen, belongs to Xiangshan County—never have Portuguese resided here.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong wrote the Zongli Yamen: "Duoweishan lies on Xiahengqin Island at Shizimen. It belongs to Xiangshan County and has never had Portuguese residents.

sentences.zh: 此處瘋人得葡人養濟，不過尋常善舉，何得視為管治證據？

translations.literal: Lunatics here receiving Portuguese charity—merely ordinary benevolent acts—how can this be regarded as evidence of governance?
translations.idiomatic: That the Portuguese had supported lepers there was merely an ordinary act of charity—hardly proof of jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 如各省常有洋人施醫院，豈能即為洋界乎？

translations.literal: As in every province foreigners often operate charity hospitals—can that immediately make foreign territory?
translations.idiomatic: Foreigners operated charity hospitals in every province—did that make each one foreign territory?

sentences.zh: 請嚴切駁復。」

translations.literal: Please sternly rebut."
translations.idiomatic: Please issue a stern rejection."

sentences.zh: 二十七年，與各國修改稅則，各國皆會同簽押，葡不派員。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, revising tariff schedules with all nations—all nations jointly signed, Portugal sent no delegate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, when tariff schedules were revised with all the treaty powers, every nation sent representatives to sign—Portugal did not.

sentences.zh: 特與照會，葡使仍不至。

translations.literal: Specially notified by note—Portuguese minister still did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Portugal was notified separately, but its minister still did not appear.

sentences.zh: 久之，始派參贊阿梅達來，仍不主改稅則。

translations.literal: After long delay, finally sent Counselor Almada—still did not advocate changing tariff schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually Counselor Almada was sent, but he still declined to agree to tariff revision.

sentences.zh: 既又請求澳門對面各島開商埠，復拒絕之。

translations.literal: Then again requested opening commercial ports on islands opposite Macao—again refused.
translations.idiomatic: Portugal then requested that commercial ports be opened on the islands facing Macao—again refused.

sentences.zh: 二十八年正月，葡使白朗谷來言：「本國商民原在澳門振興商務，修濬河道。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year first month, Portuguese minister Brandão came stating: "Our country's merchants originally at Macao promote commerce, dredge waterways.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-eighth year, Minister Brandão stated: "Our merchants have long sought to develop commerce in Macao and dredge its waterways.

sentences.zh: 前定和約，已認澳門附近屬地為葡國永居管理，應將此地之界址廣闊等項丈量妥訂。

translations.literal: The prior peace treaty already recognized dependencies near Macao as permanently managed by Portugal—should measure and properly fix this territory's boundaries, breadth, and other matters.
translations.idiomatic: The treaty already recognized nearby dependencies as territory under Portugal's permanent administration. Their boundaries and extent should now be surveyed and fixed.

sentences.zh: 按對面山一島居澳門之西，小橫琴、大橫琴二島居澳門西南，各島系澳門生成屬地，又經和約認明，請會商妥定。」

translations.literal: According to Duimianshan one island lies west of Macao; Xiahengqin and Dahengqin two islands lie southwest of Macao—each island is naturally Macao's dependency, also recognized by treaty—request joint consultation to properly fix."
translations.idiomatic: Duimianshan lies west of Macao; Xiahengqin and Dahengqin lie to the southwest. These islands are natural dependencies of Macao and were recognized as such in the treaty. We ask that their boundaries be settled through joint consultation."

sentences.zh: 外務部王大臣等復以：「中國邊海島嶼向隸府廳州縣，從無此島屬於彼島之事，祗能就澳門現管界址照約勘定，不得於界之外另有屬地。」

translations.literal: The Foreign Ministry princes and ministers replied: "China's coastal border islands always belong to prefecture, department, and county administration—never such matter as one island belonging to another island; can only according to Macao's presently administered boundaries per treaty conduct survey—not beyond boundaries have separate dependencies."
translations.idiomatic: The Foreign Ministry replied: "China's coastal islands have always fallen under prefectural and county jurisdiction. There is no principle whereby one island belongs to another. Demarcation can proceed only within Macao's presently administered area as the treaty provides—not to recognize additional dependencies beyond that boundary."

sentences.zh: 二月初，葡使復來照會，以上年各國公約第六款所載進出口稅則改為切實值百抽五，葡未與議，表明本國人民所運各項貨物，應仍照兩國條約所訂稅則辦理。

translations.literal: Second month beginning, Portuguese minister again came with note, citing last year's general convention among nations article six on import-export tariff changed to five percent ad valorem—Portugal did not participate in discussion, declaring our country's people's transported goods should still follow the two countries' treaty tariff schedule.
translations.idiomatic: In early February the Portuguese minister sent another note. The general tariff agreement of the previous year had set import and export duties at five percent ad valorem under Article Six. Portugal had not participated in those talks and now stated that goods transported by Portuguese nationals should remain subject to the rates fixed in the bilateral treaty.

sentences.zh: 王大臣等嚴詞駁拒，葡仍請求不已。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers sternly rebutted and refused—Portugal still requested without cease.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers rejected this in strong terms, but Portugal kept pressing its request.

sentences.zh: 初，葡使面稱原將界務暫置不提，但求擴充商務，開具條款，大要照分兩端。

translations.literal: Initially the Portuguese minister stated orally he originally would temporarily set aside boundary affairs without mention, only seeking to expand commerce—opening listed articles, broadly divided in two parts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Portuguese minister had said orally that he would set boundary questions aside for the moment and seek only to expand trade, submitting proposed terms divided broadly into two categories.

sentences.zh: 如應允改定稅則，稽徵洋藥稅餉，在澳門設立分關，為有益中國之款。

translations.literal: Such as if agreeing to revise tariff schedule, collect opium tax revenue, establish branch customs at Macao—these are articles benefiting China.
translations.idiomatic: Revision of the tariff schedule, collection of opium duties, and establishment of a branch customhouse at Macao would benefit China.

sentences.zh: 在澳門附近任便工程，由澳至廣東省城修造鐵路，為有益葡國之款。

translations.literal: Unrestricted construction projects near Macao, building railway from Macao to Guangdong provincial capital—these are articles benefiting Portugal.
translations.idiomatic: Unrestricted construction near Macao and a railway from Macao to the provincial capital of Guangdong would benefit Portugal.

sentences.zh: 王大臣等以澳門附近任便修造工程，仍慮暗侵界址，駁令先行刪除。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers because unrestricted construction near Macao still feared covert boundary encroachment—rejected and ordered deletion first.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers rejected the clause on unrestricted construction near Macao, fearing covert territorial encroachment, and ordered its removal.

sentences.zh: 設關一款，劄飭總稅務司赫德核辦。

translations.literal: The branch customs article—instructions issued to Inspector General of Customs Hart to examine and handle.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal for a branch customhouse was referred to Hart, Inspector General of Customs, for review.

sentences.zh: 鐵路一款，電咨前兩廣總督陶模、督辦鐵路大臣盛宣懷分別核復。

translations.literal: The railway article—telegram instructions sent to former Governor-General of the Two Guang Taomo and Railway Commissioner Sheng Xuanhuai respectively to examine and reply.
translations.idiomatic: The railway clause was referred by telegram to the former Governor-General of the Two Guang, Taomo, and to Sheng Xuanhuai, Commissioner for Railway Affairs, each to report his opinion.

sentences.zh: 旋據赫德復稱，澳門設關，有裨稅收，但章程必須妥定。

translations.literal: Shortly according to Hart's reply stating, establishing customs at Macao would benefit tax revenue, but regulations must be properly fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Hart soon reported back that a customhouse at Macao would aid revenue collection, but the regulations would have to be properly drafted.

sentences.zh: 陶模復稱由澳至省修造鐵路，于地方情形尚無妨礙。

translations.literal: Taomo replied stating building railway from Macao to province, regarding local circumstances still no obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Taomo replied that building a railway from Macao to the provincial capital presented no difficulty under local conditions.

sentences.zh: 盛宣懷復稱，造路于稅務有益，必須由總公司與之定立合同，不必列入約款。

translations.literal: Sheng Xuanhuai replied stating, building road would benefit tax affairs, must by the parent company with them fix contract, need not be listed in treaty articles.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Xuanhuai replied that the railway would benefit tax administration but must be governed by a contract between the parent company and the Portuguese side, not included in the treaty text.

sentences.zh: 王大臣等得復，復與葡使一再研商，將允造鐵路另用照會聲明，不入約內。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers obtaining replies, again with Portuguese minister repeatedly studied and discussed, would allow railway construction separately use note to declare, not enter within treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Once these replies were in, the ministers resumed negotiations with the Portuguese minister and agreed that permission to build the railway would be set forth in a separate note, not in the treaty itself.

sentences.zh: 葡使亦允從，遂與定議。

translations.literal: The Portuguese minister also agreed to follow, therefore with them fixed agreement.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister assented, and the terms were settled.

sentences.zh: 乃上言曰：「此次葡使來京，意在展拓澳界。

translations.literal: Then submitted memorial stating: "This time the Portuguese minister came to the capital, intent on expanding Macao boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: They then memorialized the throne: "The Portuguese minister came to Beijing this time intending to expand Macao's boundaries.

sentences.zh: 磋商十餘次，始將勘界之議，商允停辦。

translations.literal: Negotiated more than ten times, only then the boundary survey discussion, through consultation agreed to suspend proceedings.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a dozen rounds of talks, agreement was finally reached to suspend the boundary survey.

sentences.zh: 現與議訂條款：第一款聲明舊約照舊遵守。

translations.literal: Now with them negotiated fixed articles: first article declares old treaty according to old observance.
translations.idiomatic: The articles now agreed are as follows. Article One declares that the old treaty shall continue to be observed.

sentences.zh: 第二款聲明上年各國公約加增稅則，大西洋國均允遵照，並與訂明該國人民所納稅項，不得較別國稍有增減，以預留日後加稅地步。

translations.literal: Second article declares last year's general convention among nations added tariff schedule, the Atlantic country all agreed to follow, and with them fixed clear that country's people's paid tax items, must not compared with other countries slightly have increase or decrease, to reserve future tax increase scope.
translations.idiomatic: Article Two declares that Portugal accepts the augmented tariff schedule adopted at last year's general treaty conference, with the stipulation that duties paid by Portuguese nationals shall not be higher or lower than those paid by any other nationality, so as to preserve scope for future rate increases.

sentences.zh: 第三、第四款，在澳門設分關一道，以稽查出入澳門洋藥，並徵收各項稅項。

translations.literal: Third and fourth articles, at Macao establish one branch customs, to inspect enter-exit Macao opium, and collect various tax items.
translations.idiomatic: Articles Three and Four provide for a branch customhouse at Macao to supervise opium entering and leaving Macao and to collect applicable duties.

sentences.zh: 該關須在澳門界內。

translations.literal: That customs must be within Macao boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: The office must be located within Macao's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 但使稅司稽徵得力，似于餉項不無裨益。

translations.literal: But if tax officials collect duties effectively, seems to revenue items not without benefit.
translations.idiomatic: If collection were handled effectively, revenue would likely benefit.

sentences.zh: 第五、第六兩款，均申論設關事宜，章程由兩國酌定。

translations.literal: Fifth and sixth two articles, both expound establishing customs matters, regulations by two countries consider and fix.
translations.idiomatic: Articles Five and Six set forth arrangements for the customhouse, with detailed regulations to be determined by both sides.

sentences.zh: 第七款訂約文字。

translations.literal: Seventh article treaty text.
translations.idiomatic: Article Seven concerns the treaty text.

sentences.zh: 第八、第九款，批准互換各節，皆向來訂約應敘之款。

translations.literal: Eighth and ninth articles, ratification exchange each section, all from past treaty-making should narrate articles.
translations.idiomatic: Articles Eight and Nine cover ratification and exchange—the standard provisions found in treaties.

sentences.zh: 應請簡派大臣，與葡使定期畫押，再將約本進呈，請用御寶，以憑互換。

translations.literal: Should request appointment of minister, with Portuguese minister fix date sign, then treaty text memorialized for presentation, request imperial seal, for basis of exchange.
translations.idiomatic: A minister should be appointed to sign with the Portuguese minister on a fixed date. The treaty should then be presented for the imperial seal before exchange.

sentences.zh: 至設立中葡公司，修造由澳門至廣東省城鐵路，地僅二百餘里。

translations.literal: As to establishing Sino-Portuguese company, building from Macao to Guangdong provincial capital railway, distance only over two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: As for the planned Sino-Portuguese company to build a railway from Macao to the provincial capital of Guangdong—a distance of just over two hundred li—

sentences.zh: 現辦粵漢、九廣兩路，已議定通至省城，再添一路，亦藉以擴充商務。

translations.literal: Now operating Canton-Hankow and Kowloon-Canton two lines, already agreed extend to provincial capital, add another line, also thereby expand commerce.
translations.idiomatic: the Canton-Hankow and Kowloon-Canton lines already in progress are to run to the provincial capital; adding another line would further expand trade.

sentences.zh: 既與葡使訂明另用照會為憑，擬俟命下，即將照會互換，仍咨行督辦鐵路大臣盛宣懷與葡詳定合同，以期周妥。」

translations.literal: Having with Portuguese minister fixed clear separately use note as basis, plan await imperial command, immediately notes exchanged, still instruct Railway Commissioner Sheng Xuanhuai with Portuguese detail-fix contract, to expect thorough completion."
translations.idiomatic: Since agreement with the Portuguese minister calls for a separate exchange of notes, the notes will be exchanged as soon as orders come down, and Sheng Xuanhuai, Commissioner for Railway Affairs, will be instructed to work out the contract with the Portuguese side in full detail."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 慶親王奕劻旋畫押。

translations.literal: Prince Qing Yikuang soon signed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qing, Yikuang, then affixed his signature.

sentences.zh: 三十年二月，葡駐京使臣白朗谷照稱奉本國諭，改修稅則一事，派使前赴上海畫押，並將九月新訂增改條款暨是年十二月會訂分關章程條款內之意同語異之處，改為一律。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year second month, Portuguese minister at Beijing Brandão note stated following his country's instructions, revising tariff schedule matter, dispatch envoy proceed to Shanghai to sign, and will September newly fixed added-revised articles together with that year December jointly fixed branch customs regulations articles within same-meaning different-language places, change to uniform.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirtieth year, Minister Brandão, the Portuguese envoy in Beijing, sent a note stating that by his government's order a revision of the tariff schedule would be signed at Shanghai, and that passages in the newly added and revised articles of September and in the branch-customhouse regulations agreed in December that differed in wording but not in meaning would be harmonized.

sentences.zh: 其修改稅則及新定增改條款，並會訂分關章程條款，合訂一本，以歸畫一。

translations.literal: Its revised tariff schedule and newly added revised articles, together with jointly fixed branch customs regulations articles, combined fixed one volume, to return to uniformity.
translations.idiomatic: The revised tariff schedule, the new and amended articles, and the branch-customhouse regulations would be consolidated in a single text for the sake of uniformity.

sentences.zh: 葡使赴滬，與商約大臣呂海寰等會晤。

translations.literal: Portuguese minister went to Shanghai, with Treaty Negotiation Minister Lü Haihuan and others met.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister went to Shanghai and met with Lü Haihuan, Minister for Treaty Negotiation, and his colleagues.

sentences.zh: 海寰等面詢照會內所稱各節，將何者為意同語異，及如何改歸一律之處，詳為解明，以便會同辦理。

translations.literal: Haihuan and others face-to-face inquired note within stated each section, which would be same meaning different language, and how change to uniform places, in detail explain clearly, to facilitate joint handling.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Haihuan and his colleagues asked in person which passages in the note were said to differ only in wording and how they were to be harmonized, requesting a full explanation so that joint work could proceed.

sentences.zh: 葡使答以光緒二十八年新定增改條款及會訂分關章程條款，本國議院未經核准，不克互換。

translations.literal: Portuguese minister answered that Guangxu twenty-eighth year newly added revised articles and jointly fixed branch customs regulations articles, his country's parliament not yet approved, cannot exchange.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister replied that the newly added and revised articles of the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu and the branch-customhouse regulations had not been ratified by his country's parliament and therefore could not be exchanged.

sentences.zh: 是以此次修改商約，另行擬送條款，即將前此條款章程意同語異之處，包括在內。

translations.literal: Therefore this time revising commercial treaty, separately newly drafted sent articles, namely will prior articles regulations same-meaning different-language places, include within.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason the commercial treaty was to be revised by submitting separate draft articles that would incorporate the earlier provisions, including passages that differed only in wording.

sentences.zh: 海寰等以葡使晤對之詞與照會外務部文意不符，駁之。

translations.literal: Haihuan and others because Portuguese minister interview words with note to Foreign Ministry text meaning not accord, rebutted.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Haihuan and his colleagues held that the minister's oral statement contradicted the note sent to the Foreign Ministry and rejected it.

sentences.zh: 並照會詰問葡使，令其明晰照復。

translations.literal: And note interrogated Portuguese minister, ordered him clearly reply by note.
translations.idiomatic: They also sent a note pressing the Portuguese minister for a clear written reply.

sentences.zh: 葡使旋復，以「本國訓諭，業在外務部聲明：一，本政府准議院所議，給權於駐華公使，新立商約，即照近日各國與中國所立之商約無異。

translations.literal: Portuguese minister soon replied, stating "Our country's instructions, already at Foreign Ministry declared: one, our government approves parliament's deliberations, grants authority to minister at China, newly establish commercial treaty, namely follow recent each country with China established commercial treaties without difference.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister soon replied in a note: "By our government's instructions, already stated to the Foreign Ministry: First, our government approves what parliament has resolved and authorizes our minister in China to conclude a new commercial treaty on the same terms as the commercial treaties recently concluded between China and other powers.

sentences.zh: 二，現欲請立新約，包括光緒二十八年九月所立之條款，暨是年十二月會訂之專條，但內有更改者，俾中、葡兩國主權免有視為關礙之處。

translations.literal: Second, now wish to request establish new treaty, including Guangxu twenty-eighth year September established articles, together with that year December jointly fixed special articles, but within have revisions, so China-Portugal two countries sovereignty avoid regarded as obstructive places.
translations.idiomatic: Second, we now seek to conclude a new treaty incorporating the articles of September of the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu and the special articles agreed in December of that year, with such changes as may be needed so that neither China's nor Portugal's sovereignty is seen as impaired.

sentences.zh: 三，至於葡國協助中國防緝走私洋藥一事，奉本國政府訓諭，可將此項緝私之法整頓，以便全免走私。

translations.literal: Third, as to Portugal assisting China prevent suppress opium smuggling matter, following our government instructions, can this item anti-smuggling methods put in order, to facilitate complete elimination of smuggling.
translations.idiomatic: Third, as to Portugal's assistance to China in suppressing opium smuggling, by our government's instructions the methods of anti-smuggling enforcement may be reorganized so as to eliminate smuggling altogether.

sentences.zh: 四，因今欲立之新約，應包括光緒二十八年九月所立條款，並十二月所訂專條內之宗旨，或系更改，或系推廣，悉行包括在內。

translations.literal: Fourth, because now wished to establish new treaty, should include Guangxu twenty-eighth year September established articles, and December fixed special articles within purposes, whether revision or extension, all included within.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, because the new treaty now to be concluded should incorporate the purposes of the articles of September of the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu and of the special articles agreed in December, whether by revision or extension, all are to be included.

sentences.zh: 所以本國之意，毋庸將前約核准。」

translations.literal: Therefore our country's intent, need not ratify prior treaty."
translations.idiomatic: For this reason it is our country's view that ratification of the prior treaty is unnecessary."

sentences.zh: 海寰等電詢外務部，復云：「葡使並未向部聲明前約作廢。

translations.literal: Haihuan and others telegraphed inquiring Foreign Ministry, replied stating: "Portuguese minister did not to Ministry declare prior treaty void.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Haihuan and his colleagues telegraphed the Foreign Ministry, which replied: "The Portuguese minister did not inform the Ministry that the prior treaty was void.

sentences.zh: 當日議約，原以分關、鐵路為彼此互換利益。

translations.literal: That day negotiating treaty, originally with branch customs, railway as mutual exchanged benefits.
translations.idiomatic: The original negotiations were based on reciprocal benefit: the branch customhouse for China and the railway for Portugal.

sentences.zh: 儻不將光緒二十八年之約核准，藉包括為詞，以廢分關之議，則中國亦必將鐵路互換之照會聲明作廢。」

translations.literal: If not ratify Guangxu twenty-eighth year treaty, using inclusion as pretext, to abolish branch customs discussion, then China also must railway exchange note declaration void."
translations.idiomatic: If the treaty of the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu is not ratified and the branch customhouse is set aside under the pretext of incorporation, China will likewise treat the exchanged note on the railway as void."

sentences.zh: 海寰等即照部電直告葡使，拒不與議。

translations.literal: Haihuan and others immediately according to Ministry telegram directly told Portuguese minister, refused to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Haihuan and his colleagues relayed this telegram to the Portuguese minister at once and refused to continue negotiations.

sentences.zh: 葡使迭來商懇，以「澳門設立分關，實有礙於本國主權，故議院未能核准。

translations.literal: Portuguese minister repeatedly came pleading negotiation, stating "Macao establish branch customs, truly has obstruction to our country's sovereignty, therefore parliament could not approve.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister came repeatedly to plead, stating: "Establishing a branch customhouse at Macao would truly impair our national sovereignty, and therefore parliament could not approve it.

sentences.zh: 欲明言前約作廢，又有礙於本國體制，故以包括宗旨毋庸核准為詞」。

translations.literal: "Wishing clearly state prior treaty void, also has obstruction to our country's system, therefore using inclusion purposes need not ratify as words".
translations.idiomatic: To declare the prior treaty void outright would also be incompatible with our constitutional system, and therefore we speak of incorporation without ratification."

sentences.zh: 海寰等遂與議訂新約。

translations.literal: Haihuan and others then with them negotiated fixed new treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Haihuan and his colleagues then proceeded to negotiate a new treaty.

sentences.zh: 初，葡使送來商約款文二十條，海寰等就中摘其不能允者，往返磋商。

translations.literal: Initially, Portuguese minister sent commercial treaty draft twenty articles, Haihuan and others from among selected those not acceptable, back and forth negotiated.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Portuguese minister submitted a draft commercial treaty of twenty articles. Lü Haihuan and his colleagues singled out unacceptable provisions and negotiated back and forth.

sentences.zh: 葡使又請為寓澳華民每年准運米六百萬石，免納稅課，以資食用。

translations.literal: Portuguese minister again requested for Macao-resident Chinese annually permit transport rice six million shi, exempt pay taxes, to supply food.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister also asked that Chinese residents of Macao be allowed to import six million shi of rice each year free of duty for their subsistence.

sentences.zh: 海寰等以澳門華民不過十萬人，何至歲需六百萬石？

translations.literal: Haihuan and others because Macao Chinese not exceed one hundred thousand people, how reach annually need six million shi?
translations.idiomatic: Lü Haihuan and his colleagues replied that Macao's Chinese population did not exceed one hundred thousand—how could they require six million shi a year?

sentences.zh: 拒之。

translations.literal: Refused it.
translations.idiomatic: They refused.

sentences.zh: 旋外務部據粵督調查，每年只准運三十萬石。

translations.literal: Shortly Foreign Ministry according to Guangdong governor-general investigation, annually only permit transport three hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: The Foreign Ministry then reported, on the basis of an investigation by the Governor-General of Guangdong, that only three hundred thousand shi per year could be allowed.

sentences.zh: 又購米地方，限以廣東一省。

translations.literal: Also rice purchase place, limited to Guangdong one province.
translations.idiomatic: Purchases were further limited to Guangdong Province alone.

sentences.zh: 葡使不允。

translations.literal: Portuguese minister did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister would not agree.

sentences.zh: 久之，始將各款議定。

translations.literal: After long time, only then each article negotiated fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Only after prolonged discussion were all the articles settled.

sentences.zh: 海寰乃入奏曰：「綜計釐訂條約二十款。

translations.literal: Haihuan then submitted memorial stating: "In total examined and fixed treaty twenty articles.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Haihuan then memorialized the throne: "In all, twenty treaty articles were revised and agreed.

sentences.zh: 第一款，聲明舊約照舊遵守。

translations.literal: First article, declares old treaty according to old observance.
translations.idiomatic: Article One declares that the old treaty shall continue to be observed.

sentences.zh: 第二款，聲明和議所定加增稅則，葡國允遵照辦。

translations.literal: Second article, declares peace conference fixed added tariff schedule, Portugal agrees follow and implement.
translations.idiomatic: Article Two declares that Portugal accepts the augmented tariff schedule fixed at the peace conference.

sentences.zh: 第三款，聲明入澳門洋藥均囤於官棧。

translations.literal: Third article, declares enter Macao opium all stored at official warehouse.
translations.idiomatic: Article Three declares that all opium entering Macao must be stored in bonded warehouses.

sentences.zh: 每年澳門食用洋藥，定數以外，不得再有搬出。

translations.literal: Each year Macao consumed opium, beyond fixed quota, must not again have removal.
translations.idiomatic: No opium beyond the annual quota for Macao's consumption may be removed.

sentences.zh: 凡報運中國各處，亦應設法以防私行運往。

translations.literal: All declared transport to China various places, also should devise methods to prevent private transport thither.
translations.idiomatic: Shipments declared for destinations in China must also be guarded against clandestine diversion.

sentences.zh: 所有應定各項章程，應由彼此兩國商訂。

translations.literal: All should-be-fixed various regulations, should by both countries negotiate and fix.
translations.idiomatic: All necessary regulations are to be negotiated by both countries.

sentences.zh: 又葡國迅定律例，如有犯此約章，應分別懲處。

translations.literal: Also Portugal promptly fix laws, if violate this treaty regulations, should separately punish.
translations.idiomatic: Portugal is also to enact laws promptly so that violations of these provisions may be punished accordingly.

sentences.zh: 第四款，澳門水陸地方如何防緝走私，彼此派員會訂查緝之地位，並可行之辦法。

translations.literal: Fourth article, Macao water and land places how prevent suppress smuggling, both sides dispatch officials jointly fix inspection positions, and feasible methods.
translations.idiomatic: Article Four provides that both sides shall appoint officials to agree on positions and methods for preventing smuggling on Macao's land and waters.

sentences.zh: 第五款，照英約推廣西江各口及廣州府屬各埠行輪，惟須遵守現行一切章程。

translations.literal: Fifth article, according to British treaty extend West River various ports and Guangzhou prefecture dependencies various ports steam navigation, only must observe current all regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Article Five extends steam navigation on the West River and at ports under Guangzhou Prefecture as in the British treaty, subject to all regulations now in force.

sentences.zh: 如不遵守，仍不准照辦。

translations.literal: If not observe, still not permit according to implement.
translations.idiomatic: Noncompliance will still bar approval.

sentences.zh: 葡國並定律例，分別懲辦。

translations.literal: Portugal also fix laws, separately punish.
translations.idiomatic: Portugal is also to enact laws providing for appropriate penalties.

sentences.zh: 第六款，葡萄牙酒無葡國執照，不得照本約所附稅則納稅。

translations.literal: Sixth article, Portuguese wine without Portugal license, must not according to this treaty attached tariff schedule pay tax.
translations.idiomatic: Article Six provides that Portuguese wine without a Portuguese license may not be taxed under the tariff schedule annexed to this treaty.

sentences.zh: 第七款，通商口岸地方居住貿易。

translations.literal: Seventh article, treaty port places residence trade.
translations.idiomatic: Article Seven concerns residence and trade at treaty ports.

sentences.zh: 第八款，華人入葡國版籍，須專定律例，杜其在內地所享利益，及藉葡國籍以脫卸在華所立有合同責任。

translations.literal: Eighth article, Chinese entering Portugal registry, must specially fix laws, block their inland enjoyed benefits, and using Portuguese nationality to shed in China established contract responsibilities.
translations.idiomatic: Article Eight requires special laws on Chinese acquiring Portuguese nationality, to prevent them from retaining inland privileges or using Portuguese status to evade contractual obligations in China.

sentences.zh: 第九款，加稅免釐。

translations.literal: Ninth article, increased tax exempt likin.
translations.idiomatic: Article Nine provides for increased duties in lieu of likin.

sentences.zh: 第十款，發還海關存票。

translations.literal: Tenth article, return customs warehouse receipts.
translations.idiomatic: Article Ten concerns return of customs warehouse receipts.

sentences.zh: 第十一款，釐定國幣。

translations.literal: Eleventh article, fix national currency.
translations.idiomatic: Article Eleven fixes the national currency.

sentences.zh: 第十二款，禁止嗎啡鴉片。

translations.literal: Twelfth article, prohibit morphine opium.
translations.idiomatic: Article Twelve prohibits morphine and opium.

sentences.zh: 第十三款，振興礦務。

translations.literal: Thirteenth article, promote mining affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Article Thirteen promotes mining.

sentences.zh: 第十四款，合股經營。

translations.literal: Fourteenth article, joint-stock operation.
translations.idiomatic: Article Fourteen provides for joint-stock enterprise.

sentences.zh: 第十五款，保護貨牌及創蓺執照。

translations.literal: Fifteenth article, protect trademarks and invention licenses.
translations.idiomatic: Article Fifteen protects trademarks and patents.

sentences.zh: 第十六款，整頓律例。

translations.literal: Sixteenth article, put in order laws.
translations.idiomatic: Article Sixteen provides for revision of laws.

sentences.zh: 第十七款，籌安民教。

translations.literal: Seventeenth article, plan security for people and religion.
translations.idiomatic: Article Seventeen addresses protection of the people and religious affairs.

sentences.zh: 第十八款，條約年限。

translations.literal: Eighteenth article, treaty term.
translations.idiomatic: Article Eighteen fixes the term of the treaty.

sentences.zh: 第十九款，本約以英文為准。

translations.literal: Nineteenth article, this treaty takes English as standard.
translations.idiomatic: Article Nineteen provides that the English text shall be authoritative.

sentences.zh: 第二十款，在北京互換。

translations.literal: Twentieth article, at Beijing exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Article Twenty provides for exchange at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以上各款，為我所側重者，在洋藥緝私一事。

translations.literal: Above each article, what I emphasize, is in opium anti-smuggling one matter.
translations.idiomatic: Of the articles above, the one I emphasize most is the suppression of opium smuggling.

sentences.zh: 葡使立意，約文以渾括為准，免致議院再有疑阻。

translations.literal: Portuguese minister's intent, treaty text with comprehensive wording as standard, to avoid causing parliament again have doubts and obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister wished the treaty text to remain general so as not to provoke further objections in parliament.

sentences.zh: 商酌至再，將詳細辦法另立專章。

translations.literal: Consulted repeatedly, will detailed methods separately establish special chapter.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated consultation, detailed procedures were set forth in separate special articles.

sentences.zh: 計釐定第三款專章五條，大旨在洋藥運至澳門，必須囤入官棧。

translations.literal: In total examined and fixed third article special chapter five articles, main purport opium transported to Macao, must be stored in official warehouse.
translations.idiomatic: Five special articles were agreed under Article Three, the main point being that opium shipped to Macao must be stored in bonded warehouses.

sentences.zh: 其由棧報運中國，則由彼此會同稽查，必須完清海關稅釐，始准搬出。

translations.literal: Its from warehouse declared transport to China, then by both sides jointly inspect, must complete customs tax and likin, only then permit removal.
translations.idiomatic: Shipments from the warehouses declared for China would be jointly inspected; removal would be permitted only after customs duties and likin were fully paid.

sentences.zh: 如不進官棧，私自登岸，按葡律核辦。

translations.literal: If not enter official warehouse, privately land ashore, according to Portuguese law examine and handle.
translations.idiomatic: Landing without entering the bonded warehouse would be handled under Portuguese law.

sentences.zh: 其由原船私運中國，由拱北關緝辦。

translations.literal: Its from original ship privately transport to China, by Gongbei Customs suppress and handle.
translations.idiomatic: Clandestine shipment directly to China from the original vessel would be suppressed by the Gongbei Customhouse.

sentences.zh: 並嗣後有應行商酌加添，由澳官與稅務司商訂。

translations.literal: And hereafter if should consult add provisions, by Macao officials with tax commissioner negotiate and fix.
translations.idiomatic: Any further provisions to be added would be negotiated between Macao officials and the tax commissioner.

sentences.zh: 第五款專章十五條，在澳門專設躉船，以便由拱北關查驗由澳門來往各處貨物為要義。

translations.literal: Fifth article special chapter fifteen articles, at Macao specially establish receiving hulk, to facilitate by Gongbei Customs inspect goods from Macao to and from various places as main purport.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen special articles under Article Five provide for receiving hulks to be established at Macao so that the Gongbei Customhouse may inspect goods moving to and from Macao.

sentences.zh: 其一切限制辦法，悉照英約內港行輪章程核議。

translations.literal: Its all restriction methods, all according to British treaty inland port steam navigation regulations examine and discuss.
translations.idiomatic: All restrictive procedures were to follow the inland steam-navigation regulations of the British treaty.

sentences.zh: 迭經臣世凱、臣之洞往復籌度，公同斟酌妥善，電請外務部核准，然後與之定議。

translations.literal: Repeatedly through subject Shikai, subject Zhidong back and forth planned, jointly considered properly, telegraphed requesting Foreign Ministry approval, then with them fixed agreement.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated consultation between Yuan Shikai and Zhang Zhidong, and joint deliberation to a satisfactory conclusion, approval was telegraphed from the Foreign Ministry before final agreement with the Portuguese side.

sentences.zh: 至陸路稽徵稅項，訂明設在總車站，載入鐵路合同之內。

translations.literal: As to land route collection of tax items, fixed clear establish at main station, recorded in railway contract within.
translations.idiomatic: Land-route tax collection was stipulated for the main railway station and written into the railway contract.

sentences.zh: 又第三款，澳門食用洋藥定數，恐將來澳督與稅司多少爭執，意見不同，特用照會聲明，可由彼此在北京之代表人細查會定。

translations.literal: Also third article, Macao consumed opium fixed quota, fearing future Macao governor with tax commissioner more or less dispute, opinions differ, specially use note declare, can by both sides at Beijing representatives carefully examine jointly fix.
translations.idiomatic: As to the fixed quota for opium consumed in Macao under Article Three, fearing future disputes between the Macao governor and the tax commissioner, a note was exchanged stating that representatives of both sides in Beijing might examine the matter and fix the figure jointly.

sentences.zh: 又籌安民教一款，葡使奉其政府訓條，另備照會聲明，凡有天主教堂在華之他國已經允許者，葡國始可照辦。

translations.literal: Also plan security for people and religion one article, Portuguese minister following his government instructions, separately prepared note declare, all where Catholic churches in China other countries already permitted, Portugal then can follow accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: On the article concerning protection of the people and religion, the Portuguese minister, by his government's instructions, submitted a separate note stating that Portugal would follow suit only where other countries with Catholic churches in China had already been granted such permission.

sentences.zh: 此會訂約款章程及另備照會之情形也。

translations.literal: This jointly fixed treaty articles regulations and separately prepared notes circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: Such were the circumstances of the negotiated treaty articles, regulations, and exchanged notes.

sentences.zh: 伏念葡萄牙國以和約未經與議，不認各國修改稅則，而要索澳門分設鐵路與粵漢鐵路相接，是以外務部原議在澳門設關，以為互換利益。

translations.literal: Reflecting Portugal because peace treaty not participated in discussion, did not recognize each country revised tariff schedule, yet demanded Macao branch railway connect with Canton-Hankow railway, therefore Foreign Ministry originally proposed at Macao establish customs, to serve as exchanged benefits.
translations.idiomatic: Portugal had not participated in the general tariff agreement and did not accept the revised schedule, yet sought a branch railway from Macao linked to the Canton-Hankow line. The Foreign Ministry had therefore originally proposed a customhouse at Macao as reciprocal benefit.

sentences.zh: 今葡國以議院未能核准，前約已不廢而廢，故此次詳訂中國海關在澳門水陸地方查緝洋藥走私辦法許可權，以為補救。

translations.literal: Now Portugal because parliament could not approve, prior treaty already not abolished yet abolished, therefore this time detailed fixed China customs at Macao water and land places inspect suppress opium smuggling methods permission authority, to serve as remedy.
translations.idiomatic: Because Portugal's parliament could not approve the prior agreement, that treaty was effectively void though not formally abrogated. The present detailed provisions granting Chinese customs authority to suppress opium smuggling on Macao's land and waters were therefore adopted as a substitute.

sentences.zh: 葡使欲以新約包括前約，誠心相助，妥訂條款章程，雖無設關之名，可收緝私之實。

translations.literal: Portuguese minister wished with new treaty include prior treaty, sincerely assist, properly fix articles regulations, although without establish customs name, can obtain anti-smuggling reality.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister, wishing the new treaty to incorporate the old and offering sincere cooperation, helped settle the articles and regulations so that, though there was no customhouse in name, the substance of anti-smuggling enforcement was secured.

sentences.zh: 並由臣宣懷與葡使將粵澳鐵路合同，同兩國商董妥議，已將車站徵稅一條列入合同之內，已請外務部核准。

translations.literal: And by subject Xuanhuai with Portuguese minister the Canton-Macao railway contract, together with two countries merchant directors properly discussed, already station tax collection one article listed in contract within, already requested Foreign Ministry approval.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Xuanhuai and the Portuguese minister, together with merchant directors of both countries, also properly negotiated the Canton-Macao railway contract, including a provision on tax collection at stations, which has been submitted for Foreign Ministry approval.

sentences.zh: 忽接來電，謂廣東紳商不允葡運粵米，不能不俯順輿情，令再研商。

translations.literal: Suddenly received telegram, stating Guangdong gentry merchants do not permit Portuguese transport Guangdong rice, cannot but defer to public sentiment, ordered again study and discuss.
translations.idiomatic: A telegram then arrived stating that Guangdong gentry and merchants would not permit Portuguese import of Guangdong rice and that public sentiment could not be ignored; orders came to reopen discussion.

sentences.zh: 適葡使急於返國，不能再候，擬將米事留後再議，先將商約暨章程先行畫押。」

translations.literal: Just as Portuguese minister urgently wished return home, could not wait further, planned rice matter leave for later discussion, first commercial treaty together with regulations advance signing."
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister was eager to return home and could wait no longer. It was proposed to defer the rice question and sign the commercial treaty and regulations first."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 三十四年正月，日本船辰丸號密運槍砲彈藥向中國輸入，假泊澳門附近之過路環島東方二海里地，為中國砲艦所捕獲。

translations.literal: Thirty-fourth year first month, Japanese ship Tatsumaru secretly transported guns cannon ammunition toward China import, falsely anchored near Macao's Coloane Island east two nautical miles place, by Chinese gunboat captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-fourth year, the Japanese vessel Tatsumaru was secretly shipping arms and ammunition into China. She lay at anchor two nautical miles east of Coloane Island near Macao and was seized by a Chinese gunboat.

sentences.zh: 日本政府以系葡萄牙領海為詞，葡國政府亦言辰丸碇泊地系葡國領海。
