translations.literal: The Japanese government took as its ground that the waters were Portuguese territorial sea; the Portuguese government likewise held that the Tatsumaru's anchorage was Portuguese territorial sea.
translations.idiomatic: Japan argued that the waters were Portuguese territory, and Portugal agreed that the Tatsumaru had anchored in Portuguese territorial sea.

sentences.zh: 於是復議中、葡畫境一事，

translations.literal: Thereupon demarcation of the boundary between China and Portugal was again taken up.
translations.idiomatic: The Sino-Portuguese boundary question was therefore reopened.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，葡政府派海軍提督瑪喀多，中政府派雲南交涉使高而謙，為畫境全權大臣，會議於香港。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, the Portuguese government dispatched Rear Admiral Macado; the Chinese government dispatched Gao Erqian, Negotiation Commissioner of Yunnan, as plenipotentiaries for demarcation, to confer at Hong Kong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuantong, Portugal sent Rear Admiral Macado and China sent Gao Erqian, Yunnan's commissioner for foreign affairs, as plenipotentiaries for boundary talks in Hong Kong.

sentences.zh: 葡使初要求澳門半島及拱北、小橫琴、大橫琴、譚仔、過路環諸島，與附近海面，均為葡領，謙不允。

translations.literal: The Portuguese envoy at first demanded the Macao Peninsula together with Gongbei, Lesser Hengqin, Greater Hengqin, Taipa, Coloane, and the surrounding seas—all as Portuguese territory. Gao refused.
translations.idiomatic: The Portuguese minister initially claimed the Macao Peninsula, Gongbei, the Hengqin islands, Taipa, Coloane, and adjacent waters as Portuguese territory. Gao Erqian refused.

sentences.zh: 又要求譚仔、過路環二島，澳門半島，及拱北、大小橫琴諸島之一部，及附近海面為葡領，謙仍不允，只允譚仔、過路環二島承認為葡領，餘皆不承認。

translations.literal: He again demanded Taipa and Coloane, the Macao Peninsula, portions of Gongbei and the Hengqin islands, and the surrounding seas as Portuguese territory. Gao still refused, permitting only Taipa and Coloane to be recognized as Portuguese territory; all else he would not recognize.
translations.idiomatic: A reduced claim—Taipa, Coloane, part of the peninsula and Hengqin islands, and nearby waters—met the same response. Gao would recognize only Taipa and Coloane as Portuguese; nothing else.

sentences.zh: 相持四閱月不決。

translations.literal: They deadlocked four months without decision.
translations.idiomatic: Four months passed without agreement.

sentences.zh: 葡使請付萬國和平會議解決，謙又拒之。

translations.literal: The Portuguese envoy requested referral to the Hague Peace Conference for resolution; Gao again refused.
translations.idiomatic: When Portugal proposed submitting the dispute to the Hague Peace Conference, Gao Erqian declined once more.

sentences.zh: 旋停止會議，移議於北京。

translations.literal: Soon the conference was suspended and the negotiations moved to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Talks in Hong Kong were suspended and the venue shifted to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甫開議，會葡萄牙革命起，遂輟議，成為懸案。

translations.literal: Just as deliberations opened, a revolution broke out in Portugal; negotiations were therefore halted and the matter left unresolved.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberations had barely begun when revolution erupted in Portugal. The talks were abandoned, and the boundary remained unsettled.

sentences.zh: 墨西哥在北亞美利加洲。

translations.literal: Mexico is in North America.
translations.idiomatic: Mexico lies in North America.

sentences.zh: 光緒甲申、乙酉年間，墨以立約招工，來請中國駐美公使楊儒派員赴墨察看情形，擬定約款，電請總署籌辦。

translations.literal: Between the Guangxu jia-shen and yi-you years, Mexico, wishing to conclude a treaty for recruitment of labor, requested China's minister to the United States Yang Ru to dispatch officials to Mexico to investigate conditions and draft treaty terms, telegraphing the Zongli Yamen to arrange matters.
translations.idiomatic: During the jia-shen and yi-you years of Guangxu, Mexico sought a labor-recruitment treaty and asked Minister Yang Ru in Washington to send officials to survey conditions, draft articles, and wire the Zongli Yamen for instructions.

sentences.zh: 久未定。

translations.literal: For a long time no settlement was reached.
translations.idiomatic: Years passed without a settlement.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，駐美公使伍廷芳與墨駐美使臣盧美路重提前議。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, the minister to the United States Wu Tingfang and Mexico's minister to the United States Lu Meilu reopened the earlier discussion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Wu Tingfang, China's minister in Washington, and Mexico's minister there, Lu Meilu, took up the stalled negotiations.

sentences.zh: 會盧美路卒，繼使臣阿斯芘羅斯復議此事。

translations.literal: Lu Meilu then died; the succeeding minister Aspiros resumed negotiation of the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Meilu died before talks progressed; his successor Aspiros carried the negotiations forward.

sentences.zh: 久之，始定為二十款。

translations.literal: After a long time, twenty articles were finally fixed.
translations.idiomatic: At length the treaty was settled in twenty articles.

sentences.zh: 初，廷芳與盧美路議也，已允將前議永行墨圓一節刪除，交犯一款，允照總署來函辦法。

translations.literal: Initially, when Wu Tingfang and Lu Meilu negotiated, agreement had already been reached to delete the earlier provision on permanent circulation of Mexican dollars; as for the extradition article, it was agreed to follow the method in the Yamen's letter.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the talks with Lu Meilu, Wu Tingfang had already agreed to drop a clause on permanent Mexican-dollar circulation and to handle extradition as the Zongli Yamen directed in its letter.

sentences.zh: 至是定議。

translations.literal: At this the negotiations were finalized.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining points were now settled.

sentences.zh: 廷芳乃上奏，言：「查泰西通例，領事初到，須領駐劄之國認准文憑，方得視事。

translations.literal: Wu Tingfang then submitted a memorial, stating: "Investigating Western customary practice, when a consul first arrives he must obtain credentials of approval from the country of posting before he may assume office.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tingfang memorialized the throne, reporting: "By Western custom, a newly arrived consul must present credentials approved by the host government before he may take up his duties.

sentences.zh: 大小各國，無不皆然。

translations.literal: Great and small countries alike—all without exception.
translations.idiomatic: Every power, large or small, observes this rule.

sentences.zh: 中國除巴西約外，各國約內皆無此款。

translations.literal: China's treaties with other countries, apart from that with Brazil, none contain this provision.
translations.idiomatic: None of China's treaties except Brazil's included such a clause.

sentences.zh: 今於第三款內訂明，『領事得有認准文憑，方能視事』；

translations.literal: A consul must obtain credentials of approval before he may assume office;
translations.idiomatic: A consul must hold credentials of approval before assuming office;

sentences.zh: 『如辦事不合，違背地方條約，可將認准文憑收回』。

translations.literal: "If his conduct is improper and violates local treaty provisions, his credentials of approval may be revoked."
translations.idiomatic: "If a consul misconducts himself or violates local treaty provisions, his credentials may be revoked."

sentences.zh: 將來各國修訂條約，亦可視此為衡。

translations.literal: When other countries revise treaties in future, this may also serve as a standard.
translations.idiomatic: Future treaty revisions with other powers might well take this as a precedent.

sentences.zh: 第五款，不准誘拐華人出洋一節，是查照日斯巴尼亞約辦理。

translations.literal: Article 5, prohibiting the kidnapping of Chinese for transport overseas—this follows the Spanish treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Article 5, forbidding the abduction of Chinese laborers abroad, was modeled on the Spanish treaty.

sentences.zh: 墨約之訂，實前任使臣鄭藻如首倡其議。

translations.literal: The conclusion of the Mexican treaty was in fact first proposed by the former minister Zheng Zaoru.
translations.idiomatic: It was Zheng Zaoru, Wu Tingfang's predecessor, who had first urged a Mexican treaty.

sentences.zh: 蓋謂『出洋不必禁，誘拐則不可不防，與其受淩虐之後始行設官，不若乘未往之先妥為設法』。

translations.literal: His reasoning was that "going overseas need not be forbidden, but kidnapping must be guarded against; rather than establishing offices only after they suffer abuse, it is better to make proper provision before they go."
translations.idiomatic: He had argued that "emigration itself need not be banned, but kidnapping had to be prevented—and it was better to protect workers before they sailed than to establish offices only after they had been abused."

sentences.zh: 現定必須本人情原，不准誘令出洋，則包攬誘拐之風不禁自絕。

translations.literal: Now that it is fixed that the person himself must consent willingly and deceptive inducement to go overseas is forbidden, the practice of contract brokers and kidnapping will cease of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Requiring voluntary consent and forbidding deceptive recruitment would, Wu Tingfang argued, choke off the traffickers without further prohibition.

sentences.zh: 第六款，中國人民與列國人民一律同霑利益一節，我國人民往來貿易，與別國一律無異，將來開荒種植之事，均可援照各國章程辦理。

translations.literal: Article 6, Chinese subjects equally sharing benefits with subjects of other treaty powers—our people's coming and going in trade will be no different from those of other countries; future matters of opening land for cultivation may all follow the regulations of other countries.
translations.idiomatic: Article 6 granted Chinese the same benefits as other treaty nationals in trade and, prospectively, in land reclamation and planting on the same terms as other foreigners.

sentences.zh: 第八款，原稿『彼此土產稅則未載者，暫時免稅』。

translations.literal: The original draft said, "Native products not listed in the tariff schedules of either party shall for the time being be exempt from duty."
translations.idiomatic: The original draft said, "Products of either country not listed in the tariff schedules shall temporarily be exempt from duty."

sentences.zh: 承准總理衙門電示，遵即改為『彼此進出口稅均照相待最優之國一律辦理』。

translations.literal: Upon telegraphic instructions from the Zongli Yamen, this was promptly revised to "import and export duties of both parties shall alike be levied on the most-favored-nation basis."
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen wired instructions, and the clause was revised to "import and export duties on both sides shall be assessed on most-favored-nation terms."

sentences.zh: 此是仿照法、墨商約改訂。

translations.literal: This was revised following the Franco-Mexican commercial treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The change followed the Franco-Mexican commercial treaty.

sentences.zh: 第十款，遇有軍務，不准勒令僑民充當兵勇，不得強令捐輸一節，此是仿照英、墨約辦理。

translations.literal: Article 10, in time of military operations, not compelling overseas Chinese to serve as soldiers and not forcibly imposing levies—this follows the Anglo-Mexican treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Article 10, exempting overseas Chinese from forced military service and compulsory contributions in wartime, followed the Anglo-Mexican treaty.

sentences.zh: 第十五款，中國將來議立交涉公律一節，歐、美通例，凡僑居他國人民，遇有控告案件，均歸地方官訊斷。

translations.literal: Article 15, regarding China's future negotiation of mixed jurisdiction—in European and American practice, subjects residing in another country who face lawsuits are all tried by local officials.
translations.idiomatic: Article 15 touched mixed jurisdiction. In Europe and America, foreigners sued in a host country were tried by local courts.

sentences.zh: 惟中國與各國定約，各歸本國領事訊斷。

translations.literal: But in China's treaties with various countries, each is tried by his own country's consul.
translations.idiomatic: China's treaties, by contrast, reserved such cases to consular jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 墨國以利益均霑為詞，不得不暫行照辦。

translations.literal: Mexico pleaded equal sharing of benefits and China had no choice but to comply provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: Mexico invoked most-favored-nation treatment, and China provisionally acquiesced.

sentences.zh: 惟於約內聲明，『若中國將來與各國議立交涉公律，以治僑居中國之外國人民，墨民亦應照辦』。

translations.literal: The treaty stated, "If China shall hereafter negotiate mixed jurisdiction with other countries to govern foreign subjects residing in China, Mexican subjects shall likewise comply."
translations.idiomatic: The treaty stated, "Should China later conclude mixed jurisdictional arrangements with other powers for foreigners resident in China, Mexican nationals would be bound by the same rules."

sentences.zh: 第十六款，『凡船到口岸，船上諸色人等如有上岸在二十四點鐘內滋事者，准由地方官訊斷，罰鍰監禁』。

translations.literal: Article 16 provided, "Whenever a vessel reaches a port, if anyone aboard goes ashore and within twenty-four hours commits disorder, local officials are permitted to try the case and impose fines or imprisonment."
translations.idiomatic: Article 16 provided, "When a ship enters port, any person aboard who goes ashore and within twenty-four hours causes trouble may be tried, fined, or imprisoned by local officials."

sentences.zh: 此是創給中國官訊問外國人之權。

translations.literal: This was the first grant of authority for Chinese officials to examine foreigners.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time Chinese magistrates gained the right to question foreigners.

sentences.zh: 如地方官辦理得宜，他日各國修約，即可循此而推。

translations.literal: If local officials handle matters properly, when other countries revise treaties in future, this precedent may be extended.
translations.idiomatic: Handled well, the clause might be extended when other treaties came up for revision.

sentences.zh: 第十七款，『中國人民有事，在墨國控告，得享權利與墨國或相待最優之國人民無異』一節，查本年五月間，墨國覃壁古埠華民數百人，被工頭淩虐，剋扣工資，具詞呈訴，經臣備文由墨使轉達彼國政府，派員嚴切查辦。

translations.literal: Article 17, "When Chinese subjects have matters to bring before the courts in Mexico, they shall enjoy rights no different from those of Mexican subjects or subjects of the most-favored nation"—investigation shows that in the fifth month of this year several hundred overseas Chinese at Tanbigu port in Mexico suffered abuse and wage deductions at the hands of labor contractors and filed petitions; the minister prepared a note transmitted through the Mexican legation to their government, which dispatched officials for strict investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Article 17 guaranteed Chinese litigants in Mexico the same rights as Mexicans or nationals of the most-favored nation. That May, several hundred Chinese at Tanbigu had been beaten and cheated of wages by labor contractors; Wu Tingfang had already protested through the Mexican legation, and Mexico had promised a thorough inquiry.

sentences.zh: 惟條約未立，保護莫及。

translations.literal: But the treaty had not yet been concluded and protection could not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: Without a treaty in force, however, Beijing could offer them little protection.

sentences.zh: 今約內聲明控告事件得享權利，則遇有不平，隨時赴官剖白，于僑居商民不無裨益。

translations.literal: Now that the treaty declares rights in litigation, when injustice occurs they may at any time go before officials to state their case—a benefit to overseas merchants and sojourners.
translations.idiomatic: The new clause gave sojourners a standing right to seek redress in court whenever they suffered wrong.

sentences.zh: 以上各款，均經悉心酌定，並將漢文與英、墨文字句一一校對，皆相符合。

translations.literal: All the above articles were carefully considered, and the Chinese text was collated character by character with the English and Mexican texts—they all correspond.
translations.idiomatic: Each article had been weighed with care, and the Chinese, English, and Spanish texts checked line by line—they matched throughout.

sentences.zh: 查墨西哥國地分二十九部。

translations.literal: Investigation shows Mexico's territory is divided into twenty-nine departments.
translations.idiomatic: Mexico comprised twenty-nine departments.

sentences.zh: 其南部一歲三穫，尤為沃壤。

translations.literal: Its southern region yields three harvests a year and is especially fertile soil.
translations.idiomatic: The south could produce three crops a year and was exceptionally rich land.

sentences.zh: 民惰耕作，地利未興。

translations.literal: The people are lazy in farming and the land's potential has not been developed.
translations.idiomatic: Indolence in cultivation had left much of that fertility untapped.

sentences.zh: 近年新定招人開荒章程，一經開墾，即為永業。

translations.literal: In recent years new regulations were fixed inviting people to open wasteland; once land is opened it becomes permanent property.
translations.idiomatic: New land-opening regulations promised permanent title to anyone who cleared wasteland.

sentences.zh: 內地人稠，時虞艱食，託足海外，謀生日難，有此邦為消納之區，既可廣開利源，又可隱消患氣。

translations.literal: The interior is densely populated and food shortages are frequently feared; going abroad to make a living is difficult, and this country as a place to absorb population can both expand sources of profit and quietly dissipate social unrest.
translations.idiomatic: China's interior was crowded and often short of grain; emigration was hard to arrange at home. Mexico offered an outlet that could relieve pressure at home while opening new sources of profit abroad.

sentences.zh: 歷任使臣均以訂墨約為要務，職此之由。

translations.literal: Successive ministers all regarded concluding the Mexican treaty as an essential task—for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: That was why every minister had treated a Mexican treaty as a priority.

sentences.zh: 向例草約定後，議約之員，即須會同簽押。

translations.literal: By precedent, once a draft treaty is settled the negotiators must jointly sign and affix seals.
translations.idiomatic: Once terms were agreed, custom required the negotiators to sign and seal the draft at once.

sentences.zh: 臣隨將約本繕就，訂期十一月十二日，率同參贊隨員，將會訂條約漢文、墨文、英文各二分，覆校無訛，與墨國全權大臣阿斯芘羅斯互相畫押蓋印，咨送總理衙門，請旨批行。」

translations.literal: The minister thereupon had the treaty text copied out, fixing the date of November 12, and leading attachés and staff, had the negotiated treaty in Chinese, Mexican, and English in two copies each, rechecked without error, exchanged signatures and seals with Mexico's plenipotentiary Aspiros, and memorialized the Zongli Yamen requesting imperial approval for execution."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tingfang prepared the final text, set November 12 for the ceremony, and with his staff rechecked two copies each in Chinese, Spanish, and English before exchanging signatures and seals with Mexico's plenipotentiary Aspiros. He then submitted the treaty to the Zongli Yamen for imperial ratification."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approval granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，伍廷芳據粵商稟，咨外務部，謂：「自上年中墨訂約後，華人由香港搭船赴墨者日多。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Wu Tingfang, on the petition of Guangdong merchants, consulted the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, stating: "Since the Sino-Mexican treaty was concluded last year, Chinese traveling from Hong Kong by ship to Mexico have daily increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, acting on a petition from Guangdong merchants, Wu Tingfang wrote the Ministry of Foreign Affairs: "Since China and Mexico concluded their treaty last year, more Chinese have been sailing from Hong Kong to Mexico every day.

sentences.zh: 惟華人由香港附輪，先須假道美國三藩市埠，方能赴墨，殊非便商之道，因美正禁止華工入境故也。

translations.literal: But Chinese from Hong Kong taking steamers must first pass through the port of San Francisco in the United States before reaching Mexico—far from a convenient route for commerce, because America was then forbidding Chinese laborers entry.
translations.idiomatic: Yet travelers from Hong Kong had to call at San Francisco before reaching Mexico—a needless detour, and one made worse by America's ban on Chinese laborers.

sentences.zh: 擬商明輪船公司，特派數艘由香港逕赴墨國口岸，俾僑民任便往來。

translations.literal: It is proposed to negotiate with steamship companies to dispatch several vessels directly from Hong Kong to Mexican ports, so that overseas Chinese may come and go as they please.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that steamship lines be asked to run direct sailings from Hong Kong to Mexican ports so emigrants could travel freely.

sentences.zh: 現在中國業已換約，華人附搭輪船來往，庶不致有所窒礙。」

translations.literal: Now that China has exchanged the treaty, Chinese taking steamers back and forth should not encounter obstruction."
translations.idiomatic: With the treaty now in force, such sailings ought to proceed without hindrance."

sentences.zh: 外務部照會英公使，轉行香港總督，飭知英輪公司照辦。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs addressed a note to the British minister, requesting transmission to the Hong Kong governor to instruct British steamship companies accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs notified the British minister, asking him to relay the request to the Hong Kong governor and the British steamship lines.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，出使美日秘古國大臣梁誠咨外務部，請援古巴成案，設總領事官一，兼充參贊，駐墨國薩理那古盧司海口，遇有與外部商辦事件，即可馳赴墨都，並以美使兼攝日、秘、古三國使事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Liang Cheng, minister to the United States, Japan, Peru, and Cuba, consulted the Ministry of Foreign Affairs requesting, following the Cuban precedent, establishment of one consul-general also serving as attaché, stationed at Salina Cruz port in Mexico; when matters requiring negotiation with the foreign ministry arise he can proceed swiftly to the Mexican capital, and the American minister would concurrently supervise legation affairs for Japan, Peru, and Cuba.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Liang Cheng, minister to the United States, Japan, Peru, and Cuba, asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs—following the Cuban precedent—to appoint a consul-general doubling as legation attaché at Salina Cruz, able to reach Mexico City quickly when business with the foreign ministry arose, while the minister in Washington continued to cover Japan, Peru, and Cuba.

sentences.zh: 外務部奏請允行。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs memorialized requesting approval—it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry memorialized for approval, which was granted.

sentences.zh: 是年，墨派員充駐廣州等處領事官。

translations.literal: That year Mexico dispatched officials as consuls at Guangzhou and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Mexico appointed consuls at Guangzhou and elsewhere that year.

sentences.zh: 尋又派領事分駐上海、福州、廈門。

translations.literal: Soon consuls were also appointed at Shanghai, Fuzhou, and Xiamen.
translations.idiomatic: Consuls followed at Shanghai, Fuzhou, and Xiamen.

sentences.zh: 是年墨因防疫，禁止華人前往。

translations.literal: That year Mexico, for epidemic prevention, forbade Chinese from entering.
translations.idiomatic: Later that year Mexico barred Chinese entry on public-health grounds.

sentences.zh: 梁誠與交涉，旋弛禁。

translations.literal: Liang Cheng negotiated; soon the ban was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Cheng protested, and the restriction was soon withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 墨訂立中國及東方諸國移民入境章程六條，俾共遵守。

translations.literal: Mexico established six articles of regulations for immigration of China and Eastern countries for mutual observance.
translations.idiomatic: Mexico and China then agreed on six articles governing immigration from China and other Eastern countries.

sentences.zh: 三十年，梁誠赴墨都遞國書，開辦使署分館。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Liang Cheng went to the Mexican capital to present credentials and opened a branch of the legation.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Liang Cheng traveled to Mexico City to present his credentials and opened a legation branch office.

sentences.zh: 墨亦派使臣酈華來華遞國書，並邀覲見，請頒給墨總統暨其國各執政大臣寶星，許之。

translations.literal: Mexico also dispatched minister Li Hua to China to present credentials, requesting an audience, and asked that precious stars be conferred on the Mexican president and his cabinet ministers—this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Mexico sent Minister Li Hua to Beijing with credentials, sought an audience, and requested orders of merit for the president and cabinet—all of which were granted.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，墨前總統由國民公舉續任六年，墨致國書，由其國駐京公使烏海慕呈遞。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Mexico's former president was re-elected by the people for six years; Mexico sent credentials of state, presented by its minister to Beijing Wuhaimu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Mexico's incumbent president was re-elected for six years; Wuhaimu, the Mexican minister in Beijing, presented the new credentials.

sentences.zh: 尋由外務部擬覆國書。

translations.literal: Soon the Ministry of Foreign Affairs drafted a reply credence.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs shortly drafted a reply in the same form.

sentences.zh: 是年，墨開萬國地理會，請中國派員入會，許之。

translations.literal: That year Mexico opened an international geographical congress and invited China to send delegates—this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Mexico also invited China to an international geographical congress that year; the invitation was accepted.

sentences.zh: 剛果在亞非利加洲剛果河左右。

translations.literal: The Congo lies along the Congo River in Africa.
translations.idiomatic: The Congo Free State lay along the Congo River in Africa.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年六月，遣其使臣余式爾來華，請訂和好通商之約，許之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, it dispatched its minister Yushier to China requesting conclusion of a treaty of amity and commerce—this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu its minister Yushier arrived in China to negotiate a treaty of amity and commerce; the request was accepted.

sentences.zh: 先是光緒十一年十一月，剛果國外部大臣伊特倭照會中國，謂：「奉命充外部大臣，原與中國開通往來，遇有交涉事件，必當妥善辦理。

translations.literal: Previously, in the eleventh month of the eleventh year of Guangxu, the Congo State's minister of foreign affairs Yitewo addressed a note to China, stating: "Having been ordered to serve as minister of foreign affairs, I originally intended to open intercourse with China; should any matters requiring negotiation arise, they shall certainly be handled properly.
translations.idiomatic: As early as the eleventh month of the eleventh year of Guangxu, Congo's foreign minister Yitewo had written Beijing: "On assuming this office I meant to open relations with China and to handle any matters of negotiation in good faith.

sentences.zh: 尚望貴王大臣推誠相待，以敦睦誼。」

translations.literal: I still hope Your Excellencies the ministers will treat me with sincerity, to nurture cordial relations."
translations.idiomatic: I trust Your Excellencies will meet me in the same spirit and strengthen the bonds between our countries."

sentences.zh: 至是乃訂簡明條約二條：一，中國與各國所立約內，凡載身家、財產與審案之權，其如何待遇各國者，今亦可施諸剛果自主之國。

translations.literal: At this a concise treaty of two articles was concluded: First, among the treaties China has concluded with various countries, whatever provisions govern persons, property, and judicial authority and how each country is treated shall now likewise apply to the Independent State of the Congo.
translations.idiomatic: A brief treaty of two articles followed. First, every provision in China's other treaties governing personal status, property, and judicial rights would apply equally to the Independent State of the Congo.

sentences.zh: 二，議定中國民人可隨意遷往剛果自主之國境內僑寓居住，凡一切動產不動產，皆可購買執業，並可更易業主。

translations.literal: Second, it was agreed that Chinese subjects may freely migrate to reside within the territory of the Independent State of the Congo; all movable and immovable property may be purchased and operated, and ownership may be transferred.
translations.idiomatic: Second, Chinese might settle freely in the Congo, buy and operate movable and immovable property, and transfer ownership as they pleased.

sentences.zh: 至行船、經商、工藝各事，其待華民與待最優國之民人相同。

translations.literal: As for navigation, commerce, and crafts, Chinese shall receive treatment identical to that accorded subjects of the most-favored nation.
translations.idiomatic: In shipping, trade, and crafts they would receive most-favored-nation treatment.

sentences.zh: 各大臣先為親筆畫押，蓋用關防，以昭信守。

translations.literal: The ministers first exchanged signatures in their own hands and affixed official seals, to manifest good faith.
translations.idiomatic: Both plenipotentiaries signed in their own hands, affixed their seals, and exchanged the instruments as pledges of good faith.
